_definition: Caché local de tablas Mario Wiki (nombre, tipo, prerequisite, descripción) para availability y capturas/cappy sin red.

1.name: Infiltrate Bowser's Castle!
1.description: The player must make it to the Third Courtyard (Rear), where they must defeat the single Stairface Ogre to make the Power Moon appear.

2.name: Smart Bombing
2.description: After collecting the "Infiltrate Bowser's Castle!" Power Moon, the player must go to the Second Courtyard. Mario must collect five Moon Shards that are around the area, after which this Power Moon will appear.

3.name: Big Broodal Battle
3.description: After collecting the "Smart Bombing" Power Moon, the player must make it to the Main Courtyard Entrance. There, Mario must defeat both Hariet and Topper to make this Power Moon appear.

4.name: Showdown at Bowser's Castle
4.description: After collecting the "Big Broodal Battle" Power Moon, the player must make their way to the top of the keep, where Bowser and Princess Peach can be found. After a cutscene showing Bowser taking away Princess Peach again, the RoboBrood will appear, which Mario must defeat in order to obtain the Multi Moon .

5.name: Behind the Big Wall
5.description: At the Third Courtyard (Front) checkpoint, Mario must capture one of the Pokios and climb the wall in front of him. The Power Moon can be found on the other side on a hidden platform.

6.name: Treasure Inside the Turret
6.description: At the Second Courtyard, the player must capture a Pokio and go a short distance to the left side. The player can find a hidden wall by dropping off the side, which can be poked. The player must continue poking to the left until they find a hidden area with the Power Moon.

7.name: From the Side Above the Castle Gate
7.description: This Power Moon can be found by jumping onto the roof on the left side near the spark pylon at the end of the Second Courtyard.

8.name: Sunken Treasure in the Moat
8.description: At the Main Courtyard, this Power Moon can be found by jumping into the pool of water on the left side and swimming underneath the structure.

9.name: Past the Moving Wall
9.description: At the Beneath the Keep checkpoint, the player must go to the left side and then down three levels to find a hidden pair of moving walls around the corner that Mario must poke across with the Power Moon found inside a gate in between the pair of moving walls.

10.name: Above the Poison Swamp
10.description: At the Beneath the Keep checkpoint, the player must capture the Lakitu that can be found floating above the poisoned water. Mario must then float over to the left side where a Hat Catapult can be found, which launches Mario to the roof of a building. He must then go to the right side and can find the Power Moon on another platform near another Hat Catapult.

11.name: Knocking Down the Nice Frame
11.description: On the roof of a building near the Beneath the Keep checkpoint, the player can find a frame with Japanese writing on it. Mario must throw Cappy on the back of the frame to knock it down, which makes the Power Moon appear.

12.name: Caught on the Iron Fence
12.description: The player must throw and spin Cappy onto one of the small Bowser heads on the fence behind the Odyssey to make this Power Moon appear.

13.name: On the Giant Bowser Statue's Nose
13.description: On the nose of the giant golden Bowser head that can be seen when using the spark pylon near the Beneath the Keep checkpoint, the player can find a glowing spot. Mario must ground pound the glowing spot to obtain this Power Moon.

14.name: Inside a Block in the Castle
14.description: To the right of the Outer Wall checkpoint, the player must lure the Stairface Ogre to break a glowing metal block, which will make this Power Moon appear.

15.name: Caught Hopping at Bowser's Castle!
15.description: At the top of the keep, the player can find two rabbits . Mario must catch the rabbit on the right to obtain this Power Moon.

16.name: Exterminate the Ogres!
16.description: At the Main Courtyard Entrance checkpoint, the player can find a spark pylon on the roof of the building to the right side. This spark pylon takes Mario to a faraway island inhabited with three Stairface Ogres. Mario must defeat all three of them to obtain this Power Moon.

17.name: Bowser's Kingdom Timer Challenge 1
17.description: At the Showdown Arena, the player can find a scarecrow . Mario must throw Cappy on the scarecrow and quickly collect the Power Moon before the timer runs out.

18.name: Taking Notes: Between Spinies
18.description: At the Third Courtyard (Rear), the player can find a rainbow-colored treble clef. Mario must touch it and collect all of the notes that appear before the timer runs out.

19.name: Stack Up Above the Wall
19.description: Near the beginning of the kingdom, the player must capture and create a Goomba Stack consisting of 10 Goombas . Mario must then go to the side of the building to find a Goomba button with a number "10" that, when pressed, will make the Power Moon appear.

20.name: Hidden Corridor Under the Floor
20.description: Behind the Outer Wall checkpoint, the player can find a stack of crates inside the wall with the Power Moon being found behind a few bars.

21.name: Poking Your Nose in the Plaster Wall
21.description: At the end of the Third Courtyard (Rear), the player must jump on the roof on the left side. They must follow the roof to the far right side where they can find a Pokio on a lower level. Mario must capture the Pokio and poke the small hole in the middle of the wall to make this Power Moon appear.

22.name: Poking the Turret Wall
22.description: At the end of the Second Courtyard, the player must capture a Pokio and poke one of the firework bombs into two metal boxes on the left side. A small hole can be found behind these boxes and must be poked to make the Power Moon appear.

23.name: Poking Your Nose by the Great Gate
23.description: At the Inner Wall, the player must capture a Pokio and climb to the Beneath the Keep checkpoint. Behind the spark pylon on a lower platform, the player can find a few crates that they must destroy to reveal a hole which, when poked, will make this Power Moon appear.

24.name: Jizo All in a Row
24.description: At the Souvenir Shop checkpoint, the player must capture a Jizo and place it between the five stationary Jizos on the right to make this Power Moon appear.

25.name: Underground Jizo
25.description: At the Souvenir Shop checkpoint, the player must capture a Jizo and go to the right side to find a cracked floor which Mario will fall through into a hidden room. Mario must place the Jizo in between the two Jizos on the right side of the room to make the Power Moon appear.

26.name: Found Behind Bars!
26.description: At the Main Courtyard, the player must capture a Pokio and climb up the wall to the roof on the side with the Moon Rock. They must then go to the far left side on the roof to find a spark pylon which takes Mario to the Power Moon found inside a jail cell.

27.name: Fishing(?) in Bowser's Castle
27.description: At the Beneath the Keep checkpoint, the player must capture the Lakitu over the pool of poisoned water. They must catch the large fish there and upon reeling it in, Poochy appears along with the Power Moon.

28.name: Good to See You, Captain Toad!
28.description: At the Outer Wall checkpoint, the player can find Captain Toad on the roof to the far right side. Speaking to him will reward Mario with the Power Moon.

29.name: Shopping at Bowser's Castle
29.description: The player can purchase this Power Moon from the Crazy Cap shop for 100 gold coins .

30.name: Bowser's Castle Treasure Vault
30.description: At the Beneath the Keep checkpoint, the player can find a big door by dropping off the roof on the right side. Inside this door is a treasure chest containing the Power Moon, as well as multiple coin piles .

31.name: Scene of Crossing the Poison Swamp
31.description: The player must purchase the Samurai Helmet and Samurai Armor from the Crazy Cap shop and then go behind the shop to find a New Donker that is blocking entry to a door. Behind this door is an 8-Bit section that Mario must complete to find the Power Moon at the end.

32.name: Taking Notes: In the Folding Screen
32.description: In the area with the "Scene of Crossing the Poison Swamp" Power Moon, the player can find a rainbow-colored treble clef in the third screen. Mario must touch it and collect all of the notes that appear before the timer runs out.

33.name: On Top of the Spinning Tower
33.description: By dropping off near the Beneath the Keep checkpoint, the player can find a pool of poisoned water. The player must defeat the Stairface Ogre there to open up a door, which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must capture a Pokio and make it to the top of a spinning tower by poking onto the walls.

34.name: Down and Up the Spinning Tower
34.description: In the area with the "On Top of the Spinning Tower" Power Moon, the player must fall to a hidden alcove on the bottom of the tower to find a key. The player must then go back up to the top of the tower to obtain the Power Moon.

35.name: Jizo's Big Adventure
35.description: At the Showdown Arena, the player can find a Warp Pipe which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must capture multiple Jizos through a puzzle to find the Power Moon on top of a high platform.

36.name: Jizo and the Hidden Room
36.description: In the area with the "Jizo's Big Adventure" Power Moon, the player must capture the Jizos to have them rest on the two P Switches near the higher platform as well as a P Switch behind the entrance pipe. The Power Moon is found in a hidden alcove in the wall near the exit.

37.name: Dashing Above the Clouds
37.description: By falling off of the left side of the Beneath the Keep checkpoint, the player can find a large seed on the roof of a building. The player must plant the seed into a patch of dirt found in front of it. A large Beanstalk will grow, which takes the player to a bonus area. In this bonus area, the player must throw Cappy at multiple Rocket Flowers to make it to the end where the Power Moon is found.

38.name: Dashing Through the Clouds
38.description: In the area with the "Dashing Above the Clouds" Power Moon, the player can find this Power Moon on a narrow path to the left side.

39.name: Sphynx Over Bowser's Castle
39.description: The player must capture the Binoculars found in the Main Courtyard and zoom into the Sphynx flying over the kingdom, who will reward Mario with the Power Moon.

40.name: I Met a Pokio!
40.description: At the Main Courtyard, the player must capture a Pokio and go to the top of the right side building (where the Moon Rock is) to find the Bonneter biologist who will reward Mario with the Power Moon after speaking to it as a Pokio.

41.name: Bowser's Kingdom Regular Cup
41.description: Beneath the Keep, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

42.name: A Rumble Under the Arena Floor
42.description: At the Showdown Arena, Mario must ground pound a certain part of the floor to obtain this Power Moon.

43.name: Secret Path to Bowser's Castle!
43.description: This Power Moon can be found on top of the Island in the Sky. To reach it, the player must travel through a painting located in the Cascade Kingdom . The painting can be found underneath the large waterfall in a hidden alcove in the aforementioned kingdom.

44.name: Peach in Bowser's Kingdom
44.prerequisite: Talk to the Toad at Peach's Castle
44.description: Princess Peach and Tiara can be found at the Souvenir Shop and must be spoken with to obtain this Power Moon.

45.name: Found with Bowser's Kingdom Art
45.description: To the left of the Main Courtyard checkpoint, the player can find a piece of Hint Art . The Hint Art shows Poochy digging on a glowing spot next to a cactus in the Sand Kingdom . Mario must travel back to the Sand Kingdom and find the glowing spot that is shown on the Hint Art.

46.name: Behind the Tall Wall: Poke, Poke!
46.description: At the Third Courtyard (Rear), the player must capture a Pokio and go to the end of the area. They then must jump on the roof of the building and to the left side. On the side of the wall, a small hole can be found which Mario must poke to obtain the Power Moon.

47.name: From Crates in the Moat
47.description: At the Main Courtyard, the player should jump into the right side pool of water and can find a pile of crates underwater. One of these crates contains the Power Moon.

48.name: Caught on the Giant Horn
48.description: At the top of the keep, the player must throw and spin Cappy onto the left golden horn statue to obtain this Power Moon.

49.name: Inside a Block at the Gate
49.description: At the Main Courtyard, the player must capture a Pokio and poke a firework bomb into one of the metal boxes next to the checkpoint.

50.name: Small Bird in Bowser's Castle
50.description: A small glowing bird can be found on top of one of the buildings near the beginning of the kingdom. Mario must throw Cappy at the bird quickly before it flies away.

51.name: Invader in Bowser's Castle
51.description: At the Main Courtyard Entrance, Mario must defeat the Yoofoe that is found in the arena where Topper was fought earlier.

52.name: Jumping from Flag to Flag
52.description: Behind the Main Courtyard Entrance checkpoint, the player can find a line of flags to the left side. Mario must climb and jump across the flags to collect a key and then must go back to collect the Power Moon.

53.name: Bowser's Kingdom Timer Challenge 2
53.description: On the right building near the Beneath the Keep checkpoint, the player can find a scarecrow. Mario must throw Cappy onto the scarecrow and quickly collect the key to obtain the Power Moon before the timer runs out.

54.name: Taking Notes: On the Wall
54.description: At the end of the Third Courtyard (Rear), the player must jump onto the roof of the building and go the far right side to find a lower platform with a rainbow-colored treble clef. Mario must touch it and collect all of the notes that appear before the timer runs out.

55.name: Taking Notes with a Spinning Throw
55.description: At the Main Courtyard Entrance, the player can find a rainbow-colored treble clef where they fought Hariet earlier. Mario must touch it and collect all three sets of notes that appear before the timer runs out.

56.name: Third Courtyard Outskirts
56.description: This Power Moon is obtained by shaking the controller near a circle of coins when traveling on the spark pylon between the Third Courtyard (Front) and Third Courtyard (Rear).

57.name: Stone Wall Circuit
57.description: At the Second Courtyard, the player can find a hidden spark pylon to the right side which leads to a key, after which the player must go back to obtain the Power Moon.

58.name: Bowser's Kingdom Master Cup
58.description: Beneath the Keep, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

59.name: Searching Hexagon Tower
59.description: On a faraway building to the left side of the Main Courtyard that can only be accessed with a Hat Catapult, the player can find a Moon Pipe which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must collect five Moon Shards in a hexagon-shaped tower with Parabones to obtain this Power Moon.

60.name: Center of Hexagon Tower
60.description: In the area with the "Searching Hexagon Tower" Power Moon, the player can find a key hidden in an alcove at the very bottom of the tower. After collecting the key, the Power Moon will appear at the top of the tower.

61.name: Climb the Wooden Tower
61.description: On a faraway building to the right side of the Main Courtyard that can only be accessed with a Hat Catapult, the player can find a Moon Pipe which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must climb a large tower with walls that can be poked, including some rotating walls, by capturing a Pokio.

62.name: Poke the Wooden Tower
62.description: In the area with the "Climb the Wooden Tower" Power Moon, the player can find a few crates hidden behind the first wall of the area, one of which contains this Power Moon.

1.name: Frog-Jumping Above the Fog
1.description: The player must capture a frog near the start of the kingdom and use it to jump across some floating hat-platforms near the south side of the kingdom.

2.name: Frog-Jumping from the Top Deck
2.description: The player must capture a frog near the start of the kingdom and use it to high-jump from a stack of two hat-ships in the Central Plaza.

3.name: Cap Kingdom Timer Challenge 1
3.description: Near the base of Top-Hat Tower , the player can find a scarecrow . Mario must throw Cappy at the scarecrow, which will temporarily reveal a Power Moon at the other side of Sometimes Bridge . Mario must then collect the Power Moon before it disappears.

4.name: Good Evening, Captain Toad!
4.description: At the top of the Top-Hat Tower, the player can find Captain Toad observing the moon. Talking to Captain Toad will award the player with a Power Moon.

5.name: Shopping in Bonneton
5.description: The player can purchase a Power Moon from the Crazy Cap Shop for 100 yellow Coins .

6.name: Skimming the Poison Tide
6.description: The player needs to capture a Paragoomba and use it to fly to the back side of the Top-Hat Tower, where a door leading to a secret area can be found. Mario should enter the door and then collect the five Moon Shards within in order to reveal a Power Moon.

7.name: Slipping Through the Poison Tide
7.description: In the area with the "Skimming the Poison Tide" Power Moon, the player should use a Paragoomba to fly under the platform with the exit door in order to reach the other side of the wall, where some platforms can be found. Mario should scale up these platforms in order to reach a hidden Power Moon at the top.

8.name: Push-Block Peril
8.description: Near the top of the Top-Hat Tower, the player can find a door leading to a secret area. Mario should enter this door to find an area with several blocks that go in and out of the wall. If the player can successfully traverse these blocks, they will be rewarded with a Power Moon.

9.name: Hidden Among the Push-Blocks
9.description: In the area with the "Push-Block Peril" Power Moon, the player can find a hidden Power Moon tucked away in a hole among one of the L-shaped blocks.

10.name: Searching the Frog Pond
10.description: At the north side of the Central Plaza, the player can find a hidden door leading to a secret area. Mario should enter this area and then capture a nearby frog to collect five Moon Shards, which will reward him with a Power Moon.

11.name: Secrets of the Frog Pond
11.description: In the area with the "Searching the Frog Pond" Power Moon, the player needs to use a frog to jump up to a high ledge located on the back wall, where a Power Moon can be found.

12.name: The Forgotten Treasure
12.description: In the Central Plaza, the player should look for a Bonneter atop of a top-hat-shaped platform on a hill. Mario should talk to him, which will trigger a quest to find a "lost treasure". Cappy will lead the player around the area in search of the treasure, which is Cappy's lucky Power Moon. It is eventually found by ground pounding the stair next to the southern adjoining span of Glasses Bridge.

13.name: Taxi Flying Through Bonneton
13.description: In the Central Plaza, Mario must capture the pair of binoculars (in the north-western corner) and use them to look at a taxi flying in front of the moon. If the player stares at it for a few seconds, it will reward Mario with a Power Moon.

14.name: Bonneter Blockade
14.description: In the Central Plaza, the player should look for a Power Moon in a small alcove guarded by a Bonneter. If Mario captures a nearby Paragoomba and takes it to the Bonneter, he will get scared and run off, allowing access to the Power Moon.

15.name: Cap Kingdom Regular Cup
15.description: Near the top of the Top-Hat Tower, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario should participate in the race and then reach the finish line (located near the Odyssey) in first place. This will reward him with a Power Moon.

16.name: Peach in the Cap Kingdom
16.prerequisite: Talk to the Toad at Peach's Castle
16.description: In the Central Plaza, the player can find Princess Peach . Talking to her will reward Mario with a Power Moon.

17.name: Found with Cap Kingdom Art
17.description: In the north-eastern corner of the Central Plaza, the player can find some Hint Art showing the location of a Power Moon hidden in a different kingdom. Mario should travel to the location shown (the Moon Kingdom ) and ground pound the spot south of the Lochlady at the start in order to receive this Power Moon.

18.name: Next to Glasses Bridge
18.description: The player can find this Power Moon on top of a top-hat-shaped platform next to Glasses Bridge .

19.name: Danger Sign
19.description: The player can notice this Power Moon on a skull-marked sign over the fog near the Odyssey. To reach it, Mario must capture a Paragoomba and use it to fly over to the sign and collect the Power Moon.

20.name: Under the Big One's Brim
20.description: The player can find this Power Moon floating in the air below the top of the Top-Hat Tower. To collect it, Mario must simply drop onto it from the top of the Top-Hat Tower.

21.name: Fly to the Edge of the Fog
21.description: To collect this Power Moon, Mario must capture a Paragoomba and use it to fly to the fog in the north-eastern corner of the kingdom (behind the Top-Hat Tower), where the Moon can be seen glowing under the fog here.

22.name: Spin the Hat, Get a Prize
22.description: In the Central Plaza, the player must head to the arch at the entranceway and throw Cappy at the glowing hat-symbol here. This will reward Mario with a Power Moon.

23.name: Hidden in a Sunken Hat
23.description: Near Sometimes Bridge, the player should look for a top-hat-shaped platform with a glowing pole atop it in the fog. Mario must capture a Paragoomba and use it to fly out to this top-hat platform. He must then throw Cappy at the glowing pole on the top-hat and hold him there for a few seconds, which will cause a Power Moon to appear.

24.name: Fog-Shrouded Platform
24.description: Near the door leading to the "Searching the Frog Pond" Power Moon area, the player should notice a glowing spot on the ground just under the fog. If Mario ground pounds this glowing spot, he will receive a Power Moon.

25.name: Bird Traveling in the Fog
25.description: The player must run into a small bird (that flies over the fog around the entire kingdom) by using a Paragoomba.

26.name: Caught Hopping Near the Ship!
26.description: On a tall hill near the Odyssey, the player can find a rabbit. If Mario catches the rabbit, he will receive a Power Moon.

27.name: Taking Notes: In the Fog
27.description: To the west of the Central Plaza area, the player should look for a top-hat-shaped platform with a rainbow-colored treble clef atop it. Mario must capture a Paragoomba and use it to fly out to the treble clef, which (when collected) will temporarily spawn some notes over the fog. If the player can collect all of the notes before they disappear, Mario will receive a Power Moon.

28.name: Cap Kingdom Timer Challenge 2
28.description: In the south-eastern corner of the Central Plaza, the player can find a scarecrow. Mario should throw Cappy at the scarecrow, which will temporarily reveal some moving platforms and a key (along with a keyhole). Mario needs to then collect the key, which will unlock the keyhole and reveal a Power Moon. Finally, the player must collect this Power Moon before it disappears.

29.name: Cap Kingdom Master Cup
29.description: Near the top of the Top-Hat Tower, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario should participate in the race and then reach the finish line (located near the Odyssey) in first place. This will reward him with a Power Moon.

30.name: Roll On and On
30.description: On the west side of the Central Plaza, the player should look for a Moon Pipe . This will take Mario to a secret area with a large slide. If the player can avoid the Spinies on the slide and reach the end, they will receive a Power Moon.

31.name: Precision Rolling
31.description: In the area with the "Roll On and On" Power Moon, the player must carefully roll down a small side path near the start to find this Power Moon.

1.name: Our First Power Moon
1.description: The player must capture the first Chain Chomp of the kingdom and use it to destroy the shiny rock near the waterfall. This will reveal the game's first Power Moon.

2.name: Multi Moon Atop the Falls
2.description: The player will receive a Multi Moon after defeating Madame Broode .

3.name: Chomp Through the Rocks
3.description: The player must capture the Chain Chomp to the left of the first Big Chain Chomp in the kingdom and use it to destroy the rocks on the wall behind it.

4.name: Behind the Waterfall
4.description: In the first 2D area, the player can find an invisible block near the top (on the left side), which they can use to jump over the small wall and find a hidden Power Moon.

5.name: On Top of the Rubble
5.prerequisite: Multi Moon Atop the Falls or second visit
5.description: The player can find this Power Moon on top of some rubble near the start of the kingdom.

6.name: Treasure of the Waterfall Basin
6.description: The player can find this Power Moon in a hidden alcove in the water under the Odyssey's original location.

7.name: Above a High Cliff
7.prerequisite: Multi Moon Atop the Falls or second visit
7.description: Near the Odyssey's original location, the player must capture the nearby Chain Chomp and use it to destroy the nearby rocks on the cliff wall. This will reveal a Warp Pipe, which will take the player on top of the cliff wall, where the Power Moon is located.

8.name: Across the Floating Isles
8.prerequisite: Multi Moon Atop the Falls or second visit
8.description: The player must return to the area where Madame Broode was fought, and they should cross over the floating platforms located to the north-west of the arena in order to reach this Power Moon.

9.name: Cascade Kingdom Timer Challenge 1
9.prerequisite: Multi Moon Atop the Falls or second visit
9.description: Near the start of the Kingdom, the player can find a scarecrow. The player must throw Cappy onto the scarecrow in order to temporarily reveal some moving platforms and a Power Moon above the river. The player must then collect the Power Moon before it disappears.

10.name: Cascade Kingdom Timer Challenge 2
10.prerequisite: Multi Moon Atop the Falls or second visit
10.description: In the area where Mario fought Madame Broode, the player can find a scarecrow. The player must throw Cappy onto the scarecrow in order to temporarily reveal some blocks and a Power Moon high above them. The player must then triple jump up the blocks and collect the Power Moon before it disappears.

11.name: Good Morning, Captain Toad!
11.prerequisite: Multi Moon Atop the Falls or second visit
11.description: From the area where Mario fought Madame Broode, the player should head to a western side platform containing a Moon Rock . From this platform, the player should drop down onto a lower platform directly underneath, where Captain Toad can be found. Talking to him will give the player a Power Moon.

12.name: Dinosaur Nest: Big Cleanup!
12.prerequisite: Multi Moon Atop the Falls or second visit
12.description: Near the "Above a High Cliff" Power Moon, the player can find a door leading to a secret area. Mario should enter this area and then capture the T-Rex inside, which he can use to defeat all of the Burrbos in this area. Doing so will reveal a Power Moon.

13.name: Dinosaur Nest: Running Wild!
13.prerequisite: Multi Moon Atop the Falls or second visit
13.description: In the area with the "Dinosaur Nest: Big Cleanup!" Power Moon, the player should look for a low platform with some large rocks. If the player destroys one of them as a T-Rex (see image), a Power Moon will appear.

14.name: Nice Shot with the Chain Chomp!
14.prerequisite: Multi Moon Atop the Falls or second visit
14.description: Near the "Chomp Through the Rocks" Power Moon, the player should head around the cliff wall across some platforms to the left side in order to find a secret Warp Pipe. The player should enter the Warp Pipe to find a secret area where Mario must capture Chain Chomps in order to hit the other Chain Chomps into the target area. If Mario can do this successfully three times, he will receive a Power Moon.

15.name: Very Nice Shot with the Chain Chomp!
15.prerequisite: Multi Moon Atop the Falls or second visit
15.description: After collecting the "Nice Shot with the Chain Chomp!" Power Moon, the player should look for a secret area to the right which contains one last puzzle where a Chain Chomp must be captured in order to hit the other Chain Chomps into the target area. If Mario can successfully do this, he will receive a hidden Power Moon.

16.name: Past the Chasm Lifts
16.prerequisite: Multi Moon Atop the Falls or second visit
16.description: Near the Stone Bridge checkpoint, the player can find a door leading to a secret area. Mario should enter this door, then traverse across the platforms to reach the Power Moon at the end of the area.

17.name: Hidden Chasm Passage
17.prerequisite: Multi Moon Atop the Falls or second visit
17.description: In the secret area with the "Past the Chasm Lifts" Power Moon, the player should look for a hidden Warp Pipe located under the second 2D area. Mario should enter this Warp Pipe and then use the nearby Koopa Troopa to break through the wall on the right, which will open a secret path leading to this Power Moon.

18.name: Secret Path to Fossil Falls!
18.description: This Power Moon can be found on the Island in the Sky. To reach it, the player must travel through a painting located in a different kingdom: If the player visits the Snow Kingdom before the Seaside Kingdom, then the painting can be found on a high cliff ledge at the north end of the starting area in the Snow Kingdom. If the player visits the Seaside Kingdom before the Snow Kingdom, then the painting can be found inside the Crystal Palace at the center of the Seaside Kingdom.

19.name: A Tourist in the Cascade Kingdom
19.prerequisite: A Tourist in the Metro Kingdom!
19.description: After restoring the Sand Kingdom , the player should locate the Desert Wanderer at the Tostarena Town. Mario must talk to the Tostarenan, who states that he wants to go to the Metro Kingdom and after talking to him there, he later travels to the Cascade Kingdom and is located near the Odyssey. He gives Mario a Power Moon after he is talked to.

20.name: Rolling Rock by the Falls
20.description: Under the Odyssey's original position, Mario should find two rocks that he can break. If Mario breaks the one on the right, he will receive a Power Moon.

21.name: Peach in the Cascade Kingdom
21.prerequisite: Talk to the Toad at Peach's Castle
21.description: At the Fossil Falls Heights, the player can find Princess Peach . Talking to her will reward Mario with a Power Moon.

22.name: Cascade Kingdom Regular Cup
22.description: At the start of the kingdom, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

23.name: Caveman Cave-Fan
23.description: At the Fossil Falls Heights, Mario can find a Bonnetor who is a big fan of cavemen. If Mario talks to him with the Caveman hat and the Caveman outfit on, he will reward the player with a Power Moon.

24.name: Shopping in Fossil Falls
24.description: The player can purchase a Power Moon from the Crazy Cap Shop for 100 yellow Coins .

25.name: Sphynx Traveling to the Waterfall
25.description: At the start of the kingdom, Mario must capture the pair of binoculars and use them to look in the sky for the Sphynx . If Mario stares at the Sphynx long enough, he will reward the player with a Power Moon.

26.name: Bottom of the Waterfall Basin
26.description: Under the stone bridge next to "Our First Power Moon", the player can find a glowing spot in the water. Mario must ground pound this spot in order to reveal a Power Moon.

27.name: Just a Hat, Skip, and a Jump
27.description: Near the first 2D area of the kingdom, the player should look for some hat clouds opposite the 8-bit pipe . Mario must throw Cappy at these hat clouds to create platforms leading to a Power Moon located on a distant isle.

28.name: Treasure Under the Cliff
28.description: Near the Stone Bridge checkpoint, the player should look for the Power Moon located along the cliff face to the right. To reach the Power Moon, Mario must throw Cappy at the hat clouds underneath the Moon, which will turn into platforms. The player can then use these platforms to wall jump off the cliff wall and into the Power Moon.

29.name: Next to the Stone Arch
29.description: At the Fossil Falls Heights, the player should look for this Power Moon floating in the air next to the stone bridge leading to the boss arena. To collect this Power Moon, Mario must simply jump down from the bridge and land on it.

30.name: Guarded by a Colossal Fossil
30.description: At the Fossil Falls Heights, the player must head to the large Triceratops fossil producing a waterfall. Mario should notice that the fossil's nasal horn is glowing. If the player throws Cappy at the glowing nose and holds him there for a few seconds, Mario will receive a Power Moon.

31.name: Under the Old Electrical Pole
31.description: The player must capture the T-Rex in this kingdom (located in the south-western corner of the kingdom) and take it to the start, where a tall pole with a spark pylon can be found. If Mario destroys this pole with the T-Rex, a glowing spot will appear on the ground. The player must then ground pound this glowing spot, which will reveal a Power Moon.

32.name: Under the Ground
32.description: The player must capture the T-Rex in this kingdom (located in the south-western corner of the kingdom) and use it to destroy the rocks surrounding its resting spot. Underneath one of these rocks, a glowing spot can be found. If Mario ground pounds this glowing spot, he will receive a Power Moon.

33.name: Inside the Busted Fossil
33.description: At the Fossil Falls Heights, the player must capture a Chain Chomp and use it to destroy a fossil piece located near the pole with a spark pylon. If Mario can successfully destroy this fossil, a Power Moon will appear.

34.name: Caught Hopping at the Waterfall!
34.description: Near the Crazy Cap Shop, the player should look for a rabbit hopping around. If Mario catches the rabbit, he will receive a Power Moon.

35.name: Taking Notes: Hurry Upward
35.description: In the kingdom's first 2D area, the player should notice a rainbow-colored treble clef. Mario must collect this treble clef, as well as all the notes that appear, before they disappear in order to receive a Power Moon.

36.name: Cascade Kingdom Master Cup
36.description: At the start of the kingdom, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

37.name: Across the Mysterious Clouds
37.description: Next to the Stone Bridge checkpoint, the player can find a Moon Pipe . Mario must enter this Pipe to travel to a secret area filled with hat clouds and swinging platforms. If the player can reach the end of this area, they will be rewarded with a Power Moon.

38.name: Atop a Wall Among the Clouds
38.description: In the area with the "Across the Mysterious Clouds" Power Moon, the player should locate a group of blocks halfway through the area. Mario must use these blocks to reach the top of the red wall, where some hidden hat clouds are located. The player must traverse across these hat clouds to find a secret Power Moon.

39.name: Across the Gusty Bridges
39.description: Under the Odyssey's original position, the player can find a Moon Pipe. Mario must enter this Pipe, which will take him to an area filled with movable platforms and Wind Blow Towers . If the player can successfully traverse across the wind-affected platforms without being blown off, they will receive a Power Moon.

40.name: Flying Far Away from Gusty Bridges
40.description: In the area with the "Across the Gusty Bridges" Power Moon, the player should look for a hidden lever on the second set of yellow platforms. Mario must throw Cappy at the lever to reveal a hidden platform, allowing access to a side platform. The player must then throw Cappy through the wind gusts produced by the Wind Blow Towers in order to activate another hidden lever, which will cause a Power Moon to appear.

1.name: Broodals Over the Lake
1.description: The player will receive a Multi Moon after defeating Rango at the Water Plaza Terrace.

2.name: Dorrie-Back Rider
2.description: The player can find a Power Moon on Dorrie's back, who is located in the underwater area containing the Water Plaza.

3.name: Cheep Cheep Crossing
3.description: The player can find this Power Moon in a small alcove above the Underwater Entrance checkpoint.

4.name: End of the Hidden Passage
4.description: From the Courtyard, the player should look for a bouncy flower and use it to bounce to a higher ledge where a zipper is located. Mario should capture the zipper and use it to un-zip the wall, causing a secret path to be revealed, which leads to the Power Moon.

5.name: What's in the Box?
5.description: At the top of the Water Plaza, the player should look for a grassy ledge containing three crates - one of which is a shiny crate. If the player destroys the shiny crate, they will receive a Power Moon.

6.name: On the Lakeshore
6.description: On the sand near the Odyssey , the player can find a glowing spot. If Mario ground pounds this spot, he will receive a Power Moon.

7.name: From the Broken Pillar
7.description: Near the Water Plaza Entrance, the player can find a broken pillar submerged in the water. If the player ground pounds the top of the pillar's remains, they will receive a Power Moon.

8.name: Treasure in the Spiky Waterway
8.description: In the spiky tunnel near the start of the kingdom, the player will find a split road. Mario should lead down the right path to find a secret treasure chest, which will give the player a Power Moon once opened.

9.name: Lake Gardening: Spiky Passage Seed
9.description: At the start of the spiky tunnel near the beginning of the kingdom, the player can find a seed. Mario should take it and then plant it in a flower pot located at the Water Plaza Entrance. After planting it, the player must wait about 40 minutes for the seed to bloom, which will then cause a Power Moon to appear.

10.name: Lake Kingdom Timer Challenge 1
10.description: From the Underwater Entrance checkpoint, the player should head to the water's surface to find a platform with a scarecrow on it. Mario must throw Cappy onto the scarecrow, which will temporarily reveal some blocks and a Power Moon at the bottom of the lake. The player must then plummet down the lake to collect the Power Moon before it disappears.

11.name: Lake Kingdom Timer Challenge 2
11.description: At the Water Plaza Terrace, the player can find a scarecrow nearby. Mario must throw Cappy onto the scarecrow, which will temporarily reveal some blocks and a Power Moon at their peak. The player must then backflip up the blocks to collect the Power Moon before it disappears.

12.name: Moon Shards in the Lake
12.description: In the large lake (outside the Water Plaza), the player must locate and collect five Moon Shards , which will reward Mario with a Power Moon once collected.

13.name: Taking Notes: Dive and Swim
13.description: In the small body of water near the Odyssey, the player should look for a rainbow-colored treble clef. Mario should collect this treble clef, which will temporarily spawn some notes in the water. If the player can collect all the notes before they disappear, Mario will receive a Power Moon.

14.name: Taking Notes: In the Cliffside
14.description: From the Underwater Entrance checkpoint, the player should swim to the surface and locate an 8-bit Warp Pipe along the left wall. Mario must enter this Warp Pipe to find a rainbow-colored treble clef, which will spawn notes once collected. If the player can collect all of the notes before they disappear, Mario will receive a Power Moon.

15.name: Lake Fishing
15.description: Near the Courtyard checkpoint, the player can find a fishing Lakitu . Mario should capture the Lakitu and use it to fish for a big Cheep Cheep in the small pool, which will reward the player with a Power Moon.

16.name: I Met a Lake Cheep Cheep!
16.description: From the Underwater Entrance checkpoint, the player should capture a Cheep Cheep and then swim up to the water's surface, where a Lochlady can be found. Mario should head over to the Lochlady, who will fall in love with the Cheep Cheep and reward the player with a Power Moon.

17.name: Our Secret Little Room
17.description: At the Water Plaza Entrance, the player should enter the third alcove on the wall to find a secret door, where a hidden Lochlady can be found. Talking to her will reward Mario with a Power Moon.

18.name: Let's Go Swimming, Captain Toad!
18.description: At the Water Plaza Entrance, the player can find a deep pit of water. To reach the bottom, Mario must capture a Cheep Cheep from the lake and use it to head to the bottom of the water hole. The player can also consecutively perform underwater ground pounds in the hole to reach the bottom where Captain Toad can be found. Talking to him will reward the player with a Power Moon.

19.name: Shopping in Lake Lamode
19.description: The player can purchase a Power Moon from the Crazy Cap Shop for 100 yellow Coins .

20.name: A Successful Repair Job
20.description: Near the Water Plaza, the player can find a door leading to a secret area. Mario should enter this area and then solve the puzzle within to be rewarded with a Power Moon.

21.name: I Feel Underdressed
21.description: Next to the Water Plaza Display Window, the player can find a locked door being blocked by a Lochlady. In order to enter this door, the player needs to wear either the Swimwear outfit with the Swim Goggles hat or the Boxer Shorts outfit with any hat. Once Mario enters the room, he needs to throw Cappy at the top of the dress pedestal in the center and hold him there for a few seconds. This will reveal a Power Moon.

22.name: Unzip the Chasm
22.description: Near the Water Plaza Entrance, the player should look for a submerged zipper on the right wall. Mario must capture the zipper and use it to un-zip the wall, which will reveal a hidden door. The player must enter the door and then reach the end of the secret area within in order to receive a Power Moon.

23.name: Super-Secret Zipper
23.description: In the secret area with the "Unzip the Chasm" Power Moon, the player should look for a hidden row of blocks near the start. This will lead Mario to a secret zipper, which (when up-zipped) will reveal another hidden zipper. Un-zipping this zipper will reveal a secret Power Moon.

24.name: Jump, Grab, Cling, and Climb
24.description: Near the Water Plaza Terrace, the player should look for a hidden door along the northern wall. Mario should enter this door and then reach the end of the secret area within to receive a Power Moon.

25.name: Jump, Grab, and Climb Some More
25.description: In the secret area with the "Jump, Grab, Cling, and Climb" Power Moon, the player should ride the top of the final moving block up to a hidden bouncy flower, which will launch Mario to a treasure chest, which contains a secret Power Moon.

26.name: Secret Path to Lake Lamode!
26.description: This Power Moon can be found on top of the Viewing Balcony. To reach it, the player must travel through a painting located in a different kingdom: If the player visits the Lake Kingdom before the Wooded Kingdom and visits the Snow Kingdom after the Seaside Kingdom , then the painting can be found on a high cliff ledge at the north end of the starting area in the Snow Kingdom. If the player visits the Lake Kingdom before the Wooded Kingdom and visits the Seaside Kingdom after the Snow Kingdom, then the painting can be found inside the Crystal Palace at the center of the Seaside Kingdom. If the player visits the Lake Kingdom after the Wooded Kingdom, then the painting can be found a ledge hidden directly behind the Odyssey in the Metro Kingdom .

27.name: Found with Lake Kingdom Art
27.description: Near the Odyssey, the player can find a set of stairs leading up to the Courtyard. On the stairs, Mario should notice a picture of some dinosaur bones, with one bone missing. If the player then travels to that location (in the Cascade Kingdom ) and ground pounds the spot where a dinosaur bone should be, Mario will receive a Power Moon.

28.name: Taxi Flying Through Lake Lamode
28.prerequisite: Broodals Over the Lake and complete the game
28.description: Near the Odyssey, the player can find a pair of Binoculars. Mario must use the Binoculars and look for a flying taxi in the air over the lake. If the player can stare at the taxi for a few seconds, they will receive a Power Moon.

29.name: That Trendy "Pirate" Look
29.prerequisite: Broodals Over the Lake and complete the game
29.description: At the top of the Water Plaza, the player can find the three Style Sisters . If Mario talks to the center sister while wearing the Pirate Hat and Pirate Outfit (available at the yellow Crazy Cap Shop), she will reward the player with a Power Moon.

30.name: Space Is "In" Right Now
30.prerequisite: Broodals Over the Lake and complete the game
30.description: At the top of the Water Plaza, the player can find the three Style Sisters. If Mario talks to the left sister while wearing the Space Helmet and Spacesuit (available at the purple Crazy Cap Shop in the Moon Kingdom) or the Satellaview Helmet and Satellaview Suit, she will reward the player with a Power Moon.

31.name: That "Old West" Style
31.prerequisite: Broodals Over the Lake and complete the game
31.description: At the top of the Water Plaza, the player can find the three Style Sisters. If Mario talks to the right sister while wearing the Cowboy Hat and Cowboy Outfit (available at the purple Crazy Cap Shop in the Sand Kingdom), she will reward the player with a Power Moon.

32.name: Lake Kingdom Regular Cup
32.prerequisite: Broodals Over the Lake and complete the game
32.description: At the start of the kingdom, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

33.name: Peach in the Lake Kingdom
33.prerequisite: Broodals Over the Lake and talk to the Toad at Peach's Castle
33.description: Princess Peach and Tiara are on the Water Plaza Terrace where Mario fought Rango earlier. Peach will offer Mario a Power Moon upon speaking to her.

34.name: Behind the Floodgate
34.description: North of the Odyssey, Mario can unzip the upper level of the floodgate and drop down to the Power Moon.

35.name: High-Flying Leap
35.description: Along the cliff southeast of the main Water Plaza, there is a Hat Trampoline Mario can jump off of to grab the Power Moon floating above the water.

36.name: Deep, Deep Down
36.description: Mario must capture a Cheep Cheep and dive into the incredibly deep underwater chamber at the Water Plaza Entrance. The Power Moon is right across from Captain Toad's campsite.

37.name: Rooftop of the Water Plaza
37.description: Mario must ground pound the platform on the northeast column of the Water Plaza rooftop to reveal the Power Moon.

38.name: Bird Traveling Over the Lake
38.description: The bird can initially found on the west broken column west of the floodgate north of the Odyssey. When off its usual perch, it flies around the eastern portion of the region. Catching the bird reveals the Power Moon.

39.name: Love by the Lake
39.description: In this kingdom, Goombette is found right behind the Odyssey. Mario must capture a Goomba in the courtyard and go to her location so she can give Mario the Power Moon. This moon is somewhat tricky, as Mario must jump over water deep enough for him to lose his captured Goomba.

40.name: Lake Kingdom Master Cup
40.description: At the start of the kingdom, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

41.name: Waves of Poison: Hoppin' Over
41.description: To the right of the Odyssey, the player can find a Moon Pipe which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area Mario must capture a frog and jump across several platforms of different sizes while avoiding waves of poison .

42.name: Waves of Poison: Hop to It!
42.description: In the area with the "Waves of Poison: Hoppin' Over" Power Moon, the player should see a few platforms to the left of where the aforementioned Power Moon is located. Mario must jump across these platforms while avoiding the waves of poison to reach a key at the last left platform and then jump back to the large platform where the Power Moon will be unlocked.

1.name: Atop a Propeller Pillar
1.description: The player can find a Power Moon on the second propeller-shaped pillar near the Swamp Hill checkpoint.

2.name: Below the Cliff's Edge
2.description: The player can find this Power Moon on a low ledge at the north-eastern side of the kingdom.

3.name: Inside the Stone Cage
3.description: The player can see this Power Moon behind some stone bars near the start of the kingdom. In order to access it, Mario must ground pound the large stone block next to the cage, which will create an opening leading to this Power Moon.

4.name: On a Tree in the Swamp
4.description: The player can find this Power Moon sitting on a tree branch near the Swamp Hill checkpoint. To obtain it, Mario must capture a Tropical Wiggler and then use it to stretch himself onto the tree branch where the Power Moon awaits.

5.name: Over the Fuzzies, Above the Swamp
5.description: At the Mountainside Platform checkpoint, the player can find this Power Moon above some moving platforms. Mario must capture a Tropical Wiggler and stretch himself across the platforms and tree stumps to collect the Power Moon.

6.name: Avoiding Fuzzies Inside the Wall
6.description: At the Mountainside Platform checkpoint, the player can find this Power Moon in a 2D area on the wall. To access it, Mario must open the nearby red-cap-door, which will reveal an 8-bit pipe behind it. Entering this Warp Pipe will take Mario to the 2D area, where he must ride across the moving platforms while avoiding the Fuzzies in order to obtain the Power Moon.

7.name: Inside the Rising Stone Pillar
7.description: The player can find this Power Moon on the back side of the tallest stone pillar that forms the staircase leading up to the Swamp Hill checkpoint.

8.name: Enjoying the View of Forgotten Isle
8.description: The player can find this Power Moon on the top of a tree near the Rocky Mountain Summit checkpoint.

9.name: On the Mountain Road
9.description: While traversing up the central mountain in the kingdom, the player can find a glowing spot on the ground. If Mario ground pounds the glowing spot, he will receive a Power Moon.

10.name: A Propeller Pillar's Secret
10.description: Mario must ground pound the center of the first propeller-shaped pillar near the Swamp Hill checkpoint in order to receive this Power Moon.

11.name: Wrecked Rock Block
11.description: In the north-eastern corner of the kingdom, the player can find a shiny stone block. In order to destroy it, Mario must lure a Trapeetle near it and then throw Cappy at the Trapeetle to detonate it, which will destroy the block and reveal the Power Moon inside.

12.name: A Butterfly's Treasure
12.description: The player can find a glowing butterfly resting on a ledge just above the ground-pound switch on the path to the mountain summit. If Mario throws Cappy at the butterfly, he will receive a Power Moon.

13.name: Caught Hopping in the Jungle!
13.description: On the first propeller-shaped pillar near the Swamp Hill checkpoint, the player can find a rabbit. If Mario catches the rabbit, he will be rewarded with a Power Moon.

14.name: Cave Gardening
14.description: Near the ground-pound switch on the path to the mountain summit, the player can find a hidden cave on the back side of the mountain. Inside the cave, the player should notice several flower sprouts in the ground. If Mario throws Cappy at all the flower sprouts and blooms all the flowers, the player will be rewarded with a Power Moon.

15.name: Moon Shards in the Jungle
15.description: On the western side of the kingdom (near the Mountainside Platform checkpoint), the player should notice five Moon Shards located on the tree stumps nearby. If Mario can collect all five (by capturing a Tropical Wiggler), he will receive a Power Moon.

16.name: Peeking Out from Under the Bridge
16.description: Near the start of the kingdom, the player can find a Power Moon underneath the stone bridge. To collect it, Mario must capture a Tropical Wiggler and use its body to stretch himself into the Power Moon.

17.name: Twist 'n' Turn-Up Treasure
17.description: At the start of the kingdom, the player should look for a low ledge south of the starting position. On this low ledge, the player can find a keyhole, and they should notice a key nearby floating over the poison water. To obtain the key, Mario must capture a Tropical Wiggler and use its body to stretch out into the key. This will unlock the keyhole and reveal the hidden Power Moon.

18.name: Soaring Over Forgotten Isle!
18.description: From the Rocky Mountain Summit, Mario must capture Glydon and use him to glide over to an isolated island located to the south, where this Power Moon can be found.

19.name: The Caged Gold
19.description: Near the start of the kingdom, the player should notice a Power Moon inside a cage on top of a tree. To open the cage, Mario must use a Trapeetle from the northern ledge and lure it into destroying the cage. The player can then collect the Power Moon.

20.name: Get Some Rest, Captain Toad
20.description: On the northern side of the kingdom, the player should look for an opening near the bottom of the cliff face. To enter the opening, Mario must capture a Tropical Wiggler (from near the Mountainside Platform checkpoint) and use it to cross over the tree stumps where the Moon Shards (from the "Moon Shards in the Jungle" Power Moon) were found. At the other end of the stumps, Mario can find the cliffside opening, where Captain Toad is located. Talking to him will reward the player with a Power Moon.

21.name: Shopping on Forgotten Isle
21.description: The player can purchase a Power Moon from the Crazy Cap Shop for 100 yellow Coins .

22.name: Taxi Flying Through Forgotten Isle
22.description: Mario must capture the Binoculars next to the Koopa Troopa racer and look north-northeast while zoomed in to find a taxi sailing through the sky. Spotting it will cause the Power Moon to land on a nearby palm tree.

23.name: I Met a Tropical Wiggler!
23.description: On top of a free-standing wall east of the Swamp Hill checkpoint flag, the player can find the Bonneter biologist who is visiting the kingdom for research purposes, in hopes he will see a Tropical Wiggler up close. Mario must capture a Tropical Wiggler and, with the right elevation, present himself as a Wiggler to the Bonneter researcher to earn a Power Moon.

24.name: Lost Kingdom Regular Cup
24.description: At the start of the kingdom, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

25.name: Peach in the Lost Kingdom
25.prerequisite: Talk to the Toad at Peach's Castle
25.description: At the Rocky Mountain Summit, the player can find Princess Peach . Talking to her will reward Mario with a Power Moon.

26.name: The Shining Fruit
26.description: This Power Moon is hanging off a red-leaved palm tree that is north of the Odyssey and east of Luigi .

27.name: Jump Down to the Top of a Tree
27.description: This moon is located atop a tree trunk directly west of the Swamp Hill. Mario can either jump down from the edge of Swamp Hill or glide down from the Rocky Mountain Summit using Glydon to obtain this moon.

28.name: Line It Up, Blow It Up
28.description: On the southeast corner of Swamp Hill, there is a stack of two blocks behind a ground poundable staircase, with the upper block containing the Power Moon. Mario must ground pound said staircase so as the block stack is visible from the south. Mario must then head to east Rocky Mountain and coax a Trapeetle into blowing up the block stack, releasing the Power Moon.

29.name: Taking Notes: Stretch and Shrink
29.description: West of the western propeller pillar is a rainbow treble clef that must be accessed via Tropical Wiggler, as the path the notes form require the stretching abilities of the Tropical Wiggler. When all notes are collected in time, the Power Moon appears on the platform in between both propeller pillars.

30.name: Lost Kingdom Master Cup
30.description: At the start of the kingdom, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

31.name: Lost Kingdom Timer Challenge
31.description: There is a scarecrow located on the southeast corner of the Rocky Mountain. Throwing Cappy on it reveals a path leading back to the southeast peninsula of the region and the Power Moon atop a green-leaved palm tree northwest of the Odyssey. Mario has 10 seconds to grab the Power Moon.

32.name: Stretch and Traverse the Jungle
32.description: Next to the Odyssey, the player can find a Moon Pipe which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must capture Tropical Wigglers to make it through an obstacle course including P Switches which make walls of poisoned water sink for a limited time as well as a Fire Piranha Plant .

33.name: Aglow in the Jungle
33.description: In the area with the "Stretch and Traverse the Jungle" Power Moon, Mario must make it to the part with the Fire Piranha Plant and the large amount of Brick Blocks. He must lure the Fire Piranha Plant to light the two torches on the left and right sides, which will reward Mario with a Power Moon.

34.name: Chasing Klepto
34.description: If the player drops off the side of the Rocky Mountain Summit with the tree, they can find a Moon Pipe which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must chase down Klepto once again after he takes Cappy again. He must traverse an area filled with lava , Lava Bubbles , and Mini Goombas . After saving Cappy once more, Mario can throw him at a Lever Switch , which unlocks a cage containing the Power Moon.

35.name: Extremely Hot Bath
35.description: In the area with the "Chasing Klepto" Power Moon, Mario must capture a Lava Bubble and swim to a pillar at the far right corner of the area. Mario can find the Power Moon hiding behind the pillar and can jump as the Lava Bubble to grab it.

1.name: The Broodals Are After Some Cookin'
1.description: Mario must defeat Spewart for the second time in the game to obtain this Power Moon.

2.name: Under the Cheese Rocks
2.prerequisite: The Broodals Are After Some Cookin or Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!
2.description: Mario must make it to an area with Spinies , Hammer Bros ., and cheese rocks. He must capture a Hammer Bro and break a group of cheese rocks on a higher platform. Underneath these cheese rocks is a Lever Switch that Mario can throw Cappy on to unlock this Power Moon.

3.name: Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!
3.description: Mario must make it to the Meat Plateau checkpoint and capture the large piece of meat found here. After twitching the salt off of him, Cookatiel will catch Mario and take him to a large pot with vegetables in it. The Multi Moon can be found at the end.

4.name: Climb Up the Cascading Magma
4.prerequisite: Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!
4.description: Mario must make it to the Volcano Cave Entrance checkpoint. Inside the cave, Mario must capture a Lava Bubble and swim up a large hill of lava and Lava Geysers . At the end, he must jump into the one unlit torch still as a Lava Bubble, which will make this Power Moon appear.

5.name: Cookatiel Showdown!
5.description: Mario must make it to the Start of the Peak Climb checkpoint. He must climb up the large mountain while avoiding enemies and obstacles such as Spinies and peppers until he gets to the Top of the Peak Climb checkpoint. He must capture a Lava Bubble and launch himself from the lava cannon into a large pot where he must defeat Cookatiel.

6.name: Piled on the Salt
6.description: The player can find this Power Moon on a mound of salt on top of one of the buildings near the Odyssey .

7.name: Lurking in the Pillar's Shadow
7.description: The player can find this Power Moon in an alcove by dropping off of the building to the left behind the Peronza Plaza checkpoint.

8.name: Atop the Jutting Crag
8.description: Near the Salt-Pile Isle checkpoint, the player must capture a Lava Bubble and find a lava cannon to launch himself in the air. Mario will launch over a platform and must decapture the Lava Bubble to land on it and collect the Power Moon.

9.name: Is This an Ingredient Too?!
9.description: In the Peronza Plaza, the player can find a stack of crates behind one of the buildings there. One of the crates contains the Power Moon, which will spawn on top of one of the buildings.

10.name: Atop a Column in a Row
10.description: On top of one of the columns in the Peronza Plaza, the player can find a glowing spot. Mario must ground pound this glowing spot to obtain the Power Moon.

11.name: Surrounded by Tall Mountains
11.description: By long jumping off the Meat Plateau, the player can find a glowing spot among one of the small green mountains. Mario must ground pound it to obtain the Power Moon.

12.name: Island of Salt Floating in the Lava
12.description: Near the Salt-Pile Isle checkpoint, the player can find another small island. The island has a glowing spot in the middle of it that Mario must ground pound to obtain the Power Moon.

13.name: Overlooking a Bunch of Ingredients
13.description: If Mario jumps out of the pot that Cookatiel was fought in, he should land on a purplish blue mountain on the southwest side. At the end of the blue mountain, a glowing spot can be found which Mario must ground pound to obtain the Power Moon.

14.name: Light the Lantern on the Small Island
14.description: At the Path to the Meat Plateau, the player can find a lantern sitting on a small island that they can light. It can be lit by either capturing a Lava Bubble and jumping into it or by capturing a Fire Bro and throwing a fireball at it. The Power Moon will appear after it is lit.

15.name: Golden Turnip Recipe 1
15.description: Next to the Crazy Cap shop in Peronza Plaza, Mario can find a turnip . He must throw it into the large pot of Stupendous Stew in Peronza Plaza, which will grant him a Power Moon.

16.name: Golden Turnip Recipe 2
16.description: East of where the "Atop the Jutting Crag" Power Moon is found, Mario can find a golden turnip. He must throw it into the large pot of Stupendous Stew in Peronza Plaza, which will grant him a Power Moon.

17.name: Golden Turnip Recipe 3
17.description: At the Path to the Meat Plateau, Mario must capture a Hammer Bro and go behind the green mountain. A pile of cheese rocks can be found, which Mario must throw frying pans at to find a golden turnip underneath them. Mario must throw it into the large pot of Stupendous Stew in Peronza Plaza, which will grant him a Power Moon.

18.name: Luncheon Kingdom Timer Challenge 1
18.description: On top of one of the buildings near the Odyssey, the player can find a scarecrow . Mario must throw Cappy on it and quickly collect the Power Moon that appears before the timer runs out.

19.name: Luncheon Kingdom Timer Challenge 2
19.prerequisite: Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!
19.description: Behind the Peronza Plaza checkpoint, the player can find a scarecrow. Mario must throw Cappy on it and quickly collect the key that makes the Power Moon appear before the timer runs out.

20.name: Luncheon Kingdom Timer Challenge 3
20.description: Behind the Start of the Peak Climb checkpoint, the player can find a scarecrow. Mario must throw Cappy on it and quickly collect the key that makes the Power Moon appear before the timer runs out.

21.name: Beneath the Rolling Vegetables
21.description: At the Remote Island in the Lava, the player must enter the 8-bit pipe and can find the Power Moon at the end of the 2D area.

22.name: All the Cracks Are Fixed
22.description: At the Remote Island in the Lava, Mario must ground pound all six cracks in the ground to make the Power Moon appear.

23.name: Taking Notes: Swimming in Magma
23.description: Near the Remote Island in the Lava, the player can find a rainbow-colored treble clef sitting in the middle of the lava. Mario must touch it and quickly collect all of the notes that appear before the timer runs out.

24.name: Love Above the Lava
24.description: The player must capture a Goomba Tower and reach Goombette , who can be found near the Odyssey by walking on a floating corn . Being near her will grant Mario the Power Moon.

25.name: Shopping in Mount Volbono
25.description: The player can purchase this Power Moon from the Crazy Cap shop for 100 gold coins.

26.name: Luncheon Kingdom Slots
26.description: Behind a pile of vegetables in the Peronza Plaza, the player can find a building which houses the Slots minigame. For this version, Mario must match up five Power Moons in a row to obtain the Power Moon.

27.name: A Strong Simmer
27.description: The player must purchase the Chef Hat and Chef Suit from the Crazy Cap shop and then talk to a Volbonan blocking entry to a door to the left of the shop. Inside is a bonus area, where Mario must capture a Lava Bubble and jump into the pot of Stupendous Stew when he enters the area, which makes the Power Moon appear.

28.name: An Extreme Simmer
28.description: In the area where the "A Strong Simmer" Power Moon is found, Mario must capture a Lava Bubble again, but this time he must make it to the end of the area, where another pot of Stupendous Stew is found. Jumping into it as a Lava Bubble grants Mario the Power Moon.

29.name: Alcove Behind the Pillars of Magma
29.prerequisite: Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!
29.description: In the area where the "Climb Up the Cascading Magma" Power Moon was found, the player can find this Power Moon by going behind the part where Mario drops off into a group of Lava Geysers into a hidden alcove.

30.name: Treasure Beneath the Cheese Rocks
30.prerequisite: Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!
30.description: Near the Odyssey, the player can find a pile of cheese rocks. To break the cheese rocks, Mario must capture a Hammer Bro at the Path to the Meat Plateau and then backtrack to the very beginning of the kingdom. Mario must then throw frying pans at them to find a glowing spot underneath them. Finally, he must ground pound the glowing spot to obtain the Power Moon.

31.name: Light the Two Flames
31.prerequisite: Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!
31.description: Near the Odyssey, the player can find two lanterns that they must light using a Fire Bro to obtain the Power Moon.

32.name: Light the Far-Off Lanterns
32.prerequisite: Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!
32.description: After passing through the Volcano Cave Entrance, the player can find two lanterns near the exit. By capturing a Fire Piranha Plant , the player can spit fireballs at the lanterns. Once both lanterns are lit, the Power Moon will appear.

33.name: Bon Appétit, Captain Toad!
33.prerequisite: Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!
33.description: Near the mountain that the player climbs to get to the boss fight against Cookatiel, the player can find Captain Toad situated on a small island that is close to the edge of the kingdom. Captain Toad will reward Mario with the Power Moon once spoken to.

34.name: The Treasure Chest in the Veggies
34.prerequisite: Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!
34.description: Near the Path to the Meat Plateau, the player must jump on top of the wall to the right side of the checkpoint to find a door hidden behind the wall. Inside the door is a treasure chest containing the Power Moon.

35.name: Caught Hopping at the Volcano!
35.description: At the entrance to the Peronza Plaza, Mario can find a rabbit that he must catch to obtain this Power Moon.

36.name: Taking Notes: Big Pot Swim
36.description: In the giant pot that Mario fought Cookatiel in earlier, the player can find a rainbow-colored treble clef. The player must touch it and collect the three sets of notes that appear before the timer runs out to obtain this Power Moon.

37.name: Magma Swamp: Floating and Sinking
37.description: Near the Peronza Plaza checkpoint, the player can find a door by dropping off the ledge behind the checkpoint. Inside the door is a room filled with lava and moving platforms as well as Moon Shards that Mario must collect to obtain the Power Moon.

38.name: Corner of the Magma Swamp
38.description: In the area with the "Magma Swamp: Floating and Sinking" Power Moon, the player can find this Power Moon by going behind the entrance in the area where three sinking platforms are.

39.name: Magma Narrow Path
39.description: Near the Meat Plateau, the player can find a door which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must capture a Lava Bubble and swim across several thin paths of floating lava to find the Power Moon at the end.

40.name: Crossing to the Magma
40.description: In the area with the "Magma Narrow Path" Power Moon, the player can find this Power Moon above a "mountain" of lava to the right of two Magmatos .

41.name: Fork Flickin' to the Summit
41.description: Near the Salt-Pile Isle checkpoint, the player can find a door which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must capture multiple Volbonans and "flick" his way up to the top of a mountain where the Power Moon is found.

42.name: Fork Flickin' Detour
42.description: In the area with the "Fork Flickin' to the Summit" Power Moon, the player must use one of the Volbonans before the end of the area to flick Mario to another platform to the right side where this Power Moon is found.

43.name: Excavate 'n' Search the Cheese Rocks
43.description: At the Path to the Meat Plateau, the player must capture a Hammer Bro and go to the right side where a greenish blue structure is located. Behind the structure is a pile of cheese blocks blocking a door which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must collect five Moon Shards in a room full of cheese rocks.

44.name: Climb the Cheese Rocks
44.description: In the area with the "Excavate 'n' Search the Cheese Rocks" Power Moon, the player can find this Power Moon in a hidden alcove blocked off my a mountain of cheese rocks.

45.name: Spinning Athletics End Goal
45.description: Near the Remote Island in the Lava, the player can find a greenish structure which has a scarecrow to open a door, which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must make it through many rotating blocks to obtain the Power Moon found at the end.

46.name: Taking Notes: Spinning Athletics
46.description: In the area with the "Spinning Athletics End Goal" Power Moon, the player can find a rainbow-colored treble clef on a lime green rotating platform. Mario must touch it and collect all of the notes that appear before the timer runs out.

47.name: Secret Path to Mount Volbono!
47.description: This Power Moon can be found on top of the Floating Sky Island. To reach it, the player must travel through a painting located in a different kingdom: If the player visits the Lake Kingdom before the Wooded Kingdom, then the painting can be found behind an iron block on the iron wall in the Wooded Kingdom, which can be reached by traversing atop the wall from the Station 8 checkpoint flag. If the player visits the Wooded Kingdom before the Lake Kingdom, then the painting can be found in a small pool of water in the Courtyard of the Lake Kingdom.

48.name: A Tourist in the Luncheon Kingdom!
48.prerequisite: Cookatiel Showdown! and A Tourist in the Cascade Kingdom
48.description: After restoring the Sand Kingdom , the player should locate the Desert Wanderer at the Tostarena Town. Mario must talk to the Tostarenan, who states that he wants to go to the Metro Kingdom and after talking to him there, he later travels to the Cascade Kingdom . After talking to him in the Cascade Kingdom, the player should head to the Luncheon Kingdom, where the tourist can be found at the entrance to the Peronza Plaza. Talking to him here will reward Mario with a Power Moon.

49.name: Found with Luncheon Kingdom Art
49.prerequisite: Big Pot on the Volcano: Dive In!
49.description: At the Path to the Meat Plateau, the player can climb on top of the blueish purple mountain on the left side to find a piece of Hint Art . The Hint Art shows Poochy digging on a glowing spot on a small rock formation underwater in the Seaside Kingdom . If Mario travels to the Seaside Kingdom and ground pounds the spot shown by the Hint Art, he will be rewarded with a Power Moon.

50.name: The Rooftop Lantern
50.prerequisite: Cookatiel Showdown! and complete the game
50.description: The player must capture a Fire Bro at the Path to the Meat Plateau and then backtrack to the Peronza Plaza. On top of one of the buildings there, a lantern can be found which Mario must light to obtain this Power Moon.

51.name: Jammin' in the Luncheon Kingdom
51.prerequisite: Cookatiel Showdown! and complete the game
51.description: Behind the Peronza Plaza checkpoint, the player can find a Jammin' Toad opposite of the Scarecrow that activates the “Luncheon Kingdom Timer Challenge 2” Power Moon. Should Mario talk to the Toad, he will request that the player play a specific piece of music related to "I've become a monster!" The Toad will reward Mario with a Power Moon if the player selects the "Fossil Falls: Dinosaur", "Honeylune Ridge: Collapse", "Honeylune Ridge: Collapse (8-bit)", or "Honeylune Ridge: Escape" theme from the Music List .

52.name: Mechanic: Repairs Complete!
52.prerequisite: Cookatiel Showdown! and complete the game
52.description: The player must purchase the Mechanic Cap and Mechanic Outfit from the Yellow Crazy Cap shop. Mario must then speak to a Steam Gardener that can be found on top of a green staircase in Peronza Plaza. The Steam Gardener will tell Mario that it needs a mechanic and will reward Mario with the Power Moon.

53.name: Diving from the Big Pot!
53.prerequisite: Cookatiel Showdown! and complete the game
53.description: From the giant pot of Stupendous Stew that Mario fought Cookatiel in earlier, Mario must jump from there as a Lava Bubble into a smaller pot of Stupendous Stew found on top of a building in the Peronza Plaza. The Power Moon will appear after doing so.

54.name: Hat-and-Seek: Among the Food
54.prerequisite: Cookatiel Showdown! and complete the game
54.description: Behind one of the buildings in Peronza Plaza, the player can find a Volbonan with a Bonneter disguised as a chef hat on its head. If Mario speaks to the Bonneter, he will be rewarded with the Power Moon.

55.name: Luncheon Kingdom: Regular Cup
55.prerequisite: Cookatiel Showdown! and complete the game
55.description: Outside Volcano Cave, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

56.name: Peach in the Luncheon Kingdom
56.prerequisite: Cookatiel Showdown! and talk to the Toad at Peach's Castle
56.description: Peach can be found near the pot of Stupendous Stew in the Peronza Plaza and will reward Mario with the Power Moon when spoken to.

57.name: From Inside a Bright Stone
57.description: Behind the Peronza Plaza checkpoint and to the left side, the player can drop off the ledge and can find a blue rock with a glowing spot on it. Additionally, from where the Moon Rock was opened, Mario can capture a Lava Bubble and jump as a Lava Bubble to the blue rock. Mario must ground pound the glowing spot to obtain the Power Moon.

58.name: Under the Meat Plateau
58.description: The player must capture a Lava Bubble and swim behind a green wall near the Meat Plateau, where the Power Moon can be found hovering above the lava.

59.name: On Top of a Tall, Tall Roof
59.description: This Power Moon can be found on the roof of the entrance to the mountain peak where the two lanterns used for the "Light the Far-Off Lanterns" Power Moon are located. Due to its elevation, Mario should long jump/dive from the Top of the Peak Climb Checkpoint or from where the rolling pepper is launched.

60.name: From a Crack in the Hard Ground
60.description: By jumping on the higher ledge to the right of the Path to the Meat Plateau checkpoint, the player can find two cracks on top of it. Mario must ground pound the crack west of the three regional coins to obtain this Power Moon.

61.name: By the Cannon Pointed at the Big Pot
61.description: At the Top of the Peak Climb, the player can find a glowing spot on the orange rocks surrounding the lava cannon that launches Mario to the pot where Cookatiel was fought. Mario must ground pound the glowing spot to obtain the Power Moon.

62.name: Luncheon Kingdom: Master Cup
62.description: Outside Volcano Cave, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

63.name: Stepping Over the Gears
63.description: At the top of the Meat Plateau, the player can find a Moon Pipe which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must avoid enemies such as Fire Bros and Bitefrosts while jumping across several rotating gears.

64.name: Lanterns on the Gear Steps
64.description: In the area with the "Stepping Over the Gears" Power Moon, the player must capture a Fire Bro and light all of the lanterns that appear in the area. The Power Moon will appear at the end next to the normal Power Moon.

65.name: Volcano Cave Cruisin'
65.description: At the Volcano Cave Entrance, the player can find a Moon Pipe which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must ride a moving platform through blocks of lava as well as throw Cappy at multiple hat clouds to make it to the end.

66.name: Volcano Cave and Mysterious Clouds
66.description: In the area with the "Volcano Cave Cruisin'" Power Moon, the player can find a group of hat clouds at the corner where the moving platform goes upwards. Above these hat clouds is the Power Moon.

67.name: Treasure of the Lava Islands
