43.description: Near the Beach House, the player can find a higher cliff with a Mini Rocket on top of it which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must make it through a large chasm filled with clouds and enemies such as Pulse Beams and Burrbos .

44.name: Sunken Treasure in the Cloud Sea
44.description: In the area with the "Wading in the Cloud Sea" Power Moon, the player can find a thin pathway hidden by clouds that is off of the normal route. Following this path leads to a square platform with a treasure chest hidden in more clouds that contains the Power Moon.

45.name: Fly Through the Narrow Valley
45.description: To the right of where the Beach Volleyball minigame is played, the player can find a hidden alcove with a door that leads to a bonus area. The player must capture a Gushen first to reach it. Inside the bonus area, Mario must capture multiple Gushens to make it past several bottomless pits and pits of poisoned water.

46.name: Treasure Chest in the Narrow Valley
46.description: In the area with the "Fly Through the Narrow Valley" Power Moon, the player can find a treasure chest past the part where Mario normally falls down to collect the aforementioned Power Moon. This treasure chest contains another Power Moon.

47.name: Hurry and Stretch
47.description: In the northeast of the kingdom underwater, near the Hot Spring Island, the player can find an alcove with a door which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must capture a few Uproots and make it through an upwards area infested with Moonsnakes and rising lava. Even in Assist Mode, Mario will die and lose 10 coins if he touches lava.

48.name: Stretch on the Side Path
48.description: In the area with the "Hurry and Stretch" Power Moon in the part with the narrow path, the player can find this Power Moon floating above the right side and must stretch upwards to collect it.

49.name: Secret Path to Bubblaine!
49.description: This Power Moon can be found on top of the Diving Platform. To reach it, the player must travel through a painting located in a different kingdom: If the player visits the Snow Kingdom before the Seaside Kingdom, then the painting can be found behind the left building at the Main Courtyard Entrance in Bowser's Kingdom . If the player visits the Snow Kingdom after the Seaside Kingdom, then the painting can be found between some trees near the Odyssey in the Mushroom Kingdom .

50.name: Found with Seaside Kingdom Art
50.description: Near the gray boulders to right of the Odyssey and up on a higher platform, the player can find a piece of Hint Art . The Hint Art shows the word "KEEP" written in a blocky design with a Power Moon above the first "E". The player must travel back to the Metro Kingdom , where they can find the words "KEEP CLEAR" written on the ground near the Main Street Entrance. Mario must ground pound where the Power Moon is shown on the Hint Art to obtain it.

51.name: Seaside Kingdom Regular Cup
51.prerequisite: The Glass Is Half Full! and complete the game
51.description: At the Island above Ocean Trench East, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

52.name: Peach in the Seaside Kingdom
52.prerequisite: The Glass Is Half Full! and talk to the Toad at Peach's Castle
52.description: Mario must meet Peach at the top of the water fountain by jumping into one of the geysers.

53.name: Above the Parasol: Catch!
53.description: The player can find this Power Moon floating above the umbrella to the left of the Beach House. Mario can either jump on the umbrella to catch it or capture a Gushen and float to it.

54.name: What Shines Inside the Glass
54.description: This Power Moon can be found at the very bottom on the inside of the Glass Tower.

55.name: A Fine Detail on the Glass
55.description: This Power Moon can be found on the Glass Tower on one if its handle designs.

56.name: Underwater Highway West: Explore!
56.description: This Power Moon can be found to the west of the kingdom near a couple of rolling Moonsnakes.

57.name: Underwater Highway East: Explore!
57.description: This Power Moon can be found to the east of the kingdom near the Hot Spring Island checkpoint.

58.name: Rapid Ascent on Hot Spring Island
58.description: This Power Moon can be found high above the larger pool in the Hot Spring Island and can be obtained by capturing a Gushen.

59.name: A Light Next to the Lighthouse
59.description: The player can find this Power Moon by throwing and spinning Cappy onto the top of the pole that is used to get to the top of the Lighthouse.

60.name: The Tall Rock Shelf in the Deep Ocean
60.description: The player can find this Power Moon near the Ocean Trench East checkpoint near the Sphynx. To obtain it, Mario must throw and spin Cappy onto a small glowing rock that is sticking out of the ground to the right in the deep area.

61.name: At the Base of the Lighthouse
61.description: The player can find this Power Moon by ground pounding a glowing spot in between two blue rock formations underwater near the Lighthouse.

62.name: Bird Traveling Over the Ocean
62.description: The player can find this Power Moon by capturing a Gushen and catching a bird that is seen flying around the kingdom.

63.name: Caught Hopping at Glass Palace!
63.description: The player can find a rabbit roaming around the Glass Tower and must catch it to obtain this Power Moon.

64.name: Seaside Kingdom Timer Challenge 3
64.description: The player must throw Cappy onto a scarecrow at the top of the Lighthouse and must quickly make it to the Power Moon which can be seen on a far away platform in the water.

65.name: Taking Notes: Ocean-Bottom Maze
65.description: In the 2D area with the "Ocean-Bottom Maze: Treasure" Power Moon, the player can find a rainbow-colored treble clef. Mario must touch it and then quickly collect all of the notes that appear.

66.name: Taking Notes in the Sea
66.description: Near the Glass Palace checkpoint, the player can find a rainbow-colored treble clef on top of a column underwater. The player must touch it and quickly collect the three circles of notes before they disappear.

67.name: Seaside Kingdom Master Cup
67.description: At the Island above Ocean Trench East, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

68.name: Aim! Poke!
68.description: Near the Rolling Canyon checkpoint, the player can find a Moon Pipe underwater, which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must capture a Pokio and knock a few firework bombs into breakable blocks that are blocking the path and a gate to the Power Moon.

69.name: Poke! Roll!
69.description: In the area with the "Aim! Poke!" Power Moon, the player must capture a Pokio and knock a firework bomb into a single breakable block that can be found behind a gate which is behind the entrance to the area.

70.name: The Spinning Maze: Search!
70.description: By dropping off one side of the Lighthouse, the player can find a Moon Pipe which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must collect five Moon Shards among many blue and yellow blocks that can be shifted by throwing Cappy at them. The only enemies here are Spinies .

71.name: The Spinning Maze: Open!
71.description: At the back of the area with "The Spinning Maze: Search!" Power Moon, the player can find an opening which leads to a hidden room containing a treasure chest which contains the Power Moon.

1.name: The Icicle Barrier
1.description: The player can find this Power Moon at the end of the Icicle Cavern area.

2.name: The Ice Wall Barrier
2.description: The player must collect all five Moon Shards in the Hollow Crevasse area in order to receive this Power Moon.

3.name: The Gusty Barrier
3.description: The player must defeat all the Spinies on the last platform of the Wind-Chill Cavern area in order to receive this Power Moon.

4.name: The Snowy Mountain Barrier
4.description: The player must defeat Rango on top of the Snowy Mountain area in order to receive this Power Moon.

5.name: The Bound Bowl Grand Prix
5.description: The player will receive a Multi Moon upon getting first place in the Snowline Circuit Class A race.

6.name: Entrance to Shiveria
6.description: The player can find this Power Moon on top of some boxes at the entrance to the Shiverian town.

7.name: Behind Snowy Mountain
7.description: The player can find this Power Moon on a hidden path located behind the Snowy Mountain.

8.name: Shining in the Snow in Town
8.description: In Shiveria Town, the player can find a pole that they must climb to a higher level proceeded by three lamps that Mario can climb. In the snow after these three lamps, Mario can find a glowing spot in the top left corner that he must ground pound to make the Power Moon appear.

9.name: Atop a Blustery Arch
9.description: In the Wind-Chill Cavern, Mario must ground pound an x-shaped indent on top of the wooden archway that has a moving block inside it.

10.name: Caught Hopping in the Snow!
10.description: Southeast of the Odyssey, the player can find a rabbit that they must catch in order to obtain the Power Moon.

11.name: The Shiverian Treasure Chest
11.description: Near the "Shining in the Snow in Town" Power Moon, Mario can find a hole past it that leads to a pathway to a treasure chest containing this Power Moon.

12.name: Treasure in the Ice Wall
12.description: In the Hollow Crevasse, the player must make it to the top of the area with the last Bitefrost. They can find a small indent that allows Mario to climb on the wall and can climb to the far right side to find a treasure chest containing the Power Moon.

13.name: Snow Kingdom Timer Challenge 1
13.description: In the northeast of the outside area near the "Corner of the Freezing Sea" checkpoint, Mario can find a scarecrow that he can throw Cappy on. He must quickly make it across several small circular platforms to reach this Power Moon.

14.name: Snow Kingdom Timer Challenge 2
14.description: In the middle of the southeast of the outside area, Mario can find a scarecrow that he can throw Cappy on. He must quickly climb two tall poles to the top where he can find the Power Moon.

15.name: Moon Shards in the Snow
15.description: In the outside area, the player must find five Moon Shards throughout the area after which he will be rewarded with the Power Moon.

16.name: Taking Notes: Snow Path Dash
16.description: To the northwest of the Above the Ice Well checkpoint the player can find a rainbow treble clef. After touching it, Mario must collect three different lines of rainbow notes in order to obtain this Power Moon.

17.name: Fishing in the Glacier!
17.description: To the far east of the Odyssey, the player can find a pool of water with a Lakitu with a fishing rod. Mario must capture the Lakitu and reel in the bigger shadow to make a Cheep Cheep appear as well as the Power Moon.

18.name: Ice-Dodging Goomba Stack
18.description: In the Icicle Cavern, Mario must capture and create a Goomba Stack consisting of at least four Goombas and find a Goomba button with a number "4" to a higher platform on the right, which will cause a hole in the wall containing the Power Moon to open up.

19.name: Captain Toad is Chilly!
19.description: In the outside area at the far north, the player can find a hole with snow in it that Captain Toad is hiding in. Mario must talk to him and he will give Mario the Power Moon.

20.name: I'm Not Cold!
20.description: In the Shiveria Town, the player must talk to a Shiverian across from the Crazy Cap shop while wearing the Boxer Shorts. The Shiverian will reward Mario with the Power Moon.

21.name: Shopping in Shiveria
21.description: In the Shiveria Town, the player must purchase a Power Moon from the Crazy Cap shop for 100 gold coins.

22.name: Walking on Ice!
22.description: In front of the Corner of the Freezing Sea checkpoint the player can find a door which leads to a Koopa Troopa inside an ice cave. Mario must talk to him and earn 80 or more points in the Koopa Trace-Walking minigame to obtain this Power Moon.

23.name: Snowline Circuit Class S
23.description: The player will receive this Power Moon upon getting first place in the Snowline Circuit Class S race.

24.name: Dashing Over Cold Water!
24.description: In the west in the outside area the player can find a door covered in a pile of snow which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must capture many Rocket Flowers across freezing water while avoiding Moonsnakes .

25.name: Dashing Above and Beyond!
25.prerequisite: The Bound Bowl Grand Prix*<ref name="rocket-flower-early" />
25.description: In the area with the "Dashing Over Cold Water" Power Moon, the player must dash past the Power Moon and the Warp Pipe up the steep hill to find the Power Moon and a Shiverian at the very top.

26.name: Jump 'n' Swim in the Freezing Water
26.description: A little bit north of the Odyssey, the player can find a door that can only be opened by throwing Cappy on the scarecrow, which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must make it through many moving blocks of freezing water while avoiding Goombas wearing Santa hats. Cappy cannot be used in this area due to throwing Cappy on the scarecrow to open the blue door.

27.name: Freezing Water Near the Ceiling
27.prerequisite: The Bound Bowl Grand Prix*<ref name="freezing-water-early" />
27.description: In the area with the "Jump 'n' Swim in the Freezing Water" Power Moon, Mario must jump on top of the last block of freezing water. This block leads up to a series of bars going to the left side into a floating block of freezing water which contains the Power Moon.

28.name: Blowing and Sliding
28.description: The player must capture one of the Ty-foos and float over to a block hidden behind a cliff in the east side of the outside area. Mario must blow the block off to the side to reveal a hidden door, which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must blow the two blocks into the correct order in order to create a staircase up to the Power Moon and unlock it.

29.name: Moon Shards in the Cold Room
29.description: In the Shiverian Town, the player must purchase the Snow Hood and Snow Suit from the Crazy Cap shop. Mario must then climb up the pole on the right side near the bounding track entrance to a Shiverian on the upper level. Mario must talk to the Shiverian who will open the door to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must collect Moon Shards inside an 8-Bit section while avoiding Spinies.

30.name: Slip Behind the Ice
30.description: In the area with the "Moon Shards in the Cold Room" Power Moon, Mario can find a few hidden blocks above the platform near the entrance/exit pipe. Mario must jump on top of these blocks into a hidden alcove with the Power Moon found at the very left side.

31.name: Spinning Above the Clouds
31.description: Near the Above the Ice Well checkpoint, the player can find a large seed frozen in a small piece of ice. The player must plant the seed in the small patch of dirt near the Odyssey, which causes a large beanstalk to grow, which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must make it across multiple Hat Trampolines while being blown upwards by gusts of wind. There is also a massive amount of coin rings found here.

32.name: High-Altitude Spinning
32.description: In the area with the "Spinning Above the Clouds" Power Moon, the player must make it to the extra tall gust of wind and float over to a lone Hat Trampoline on the left side, which has the Power Moon above it.

33.name: Secret Path to Shiveria!
33.description: This Power Moon can be found on top of the Snow Kingdom Clifftop. To reach it, the player must travel through a painting located in a different kingdom: If the player visits the Snow Kingdom before the Seaside Kingdom , then the painting can be found between some trees near the Odyssey in the Mushroom Kingdom . If the player visits the Snow Kingdom after the Seaside Kingdom, then the painting can be found behind the left building at the Main Courtyard Entrance in Bowser's Kingdom .

34.name: Found with Snow Kingdom Art
34.description: When the player falls down into the Shiveria Town, they should walk to the left side to find a piece of Hint Art . The Hint Art shows Poochy sitting on a glowing spot in the Lost Kingdom . Mario must travel back to the Lost Kingdom and find the glowing spot that is shown on the Hint Art.

35.name: Snow Kingdom Regular Cup
35.prerequisite: The Bound Bowl Grand Prix and complete the game
35.description: At the northwest corner of the kingdom, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

36.name: Hat-and-Seek in the Snow
36.prerequisite: The Bound Bowl Grand Prix and complete the game
36.description: At the Snowline Circuit, the player can find a Bonneter on the head of one of the Shiverians. After speaking to the Bonneter, Mario will be rewarded with a Power Moon.

37.name: Peach in the Snow Kingdom
37.prerequisite: The Bound Bowl Grand Prix and talk to the Toad at Peach's Castle
37.description: In the Shiveria Town on the left side near the entrance to the bounding track, Peach and Tiara can be found. If Mario talks to Peach, she will reward him with a Power Moon.

38.name: Shining on High
38.description: This Power Moon is found floating above near the Odyssey. Mario can grab it simply by jumping on top of the Odyssey and long jumping to it.

39.name: Above the Freezing Fishing Pond
39.description: To the south of the Corner of the Freezing Sea checkpoint, the player can find the Power Moon floating above near a pool of water on a thin part of the hill.

40.name: Ice Floe Swimming
40.description: Near the "Above the Freezing Fishing Pond" Power Moon, the player can find this Power Moon in a long hole underwater, which can be grabbed easier by capturing a nearby Cheep Cheep.

41.name: Icy Jump Challenge
41.description: In the Wind-Chill Cavern, the player can find this Power Moon floating above the path of one of the blocks that are being blown around by the Ty-foos. Mario must jump on the moving block and quickly jump up to grab the Power Moon.

42.name: Forgotten in the Holding Room
42.description: In the waiting room that is used by the capturable Shiverian for the bounding races, the player can find this Power Moon hidden among one of the stacks of crates .

43.name: It Popped Out of the Ice
43.description: Near the Above the Ice Well checkpoint, the player can find this Power Moon on top of one of the tall blocks of ice. The Power Moon is hidden by a glowing spot, which Mario must ground pound to make it appear.

44.name: Deep in the Cold, Cold Water
44.description: In the deep pool of water found to the left of the Corner of the Freezing Sea checkpoint, the player can find a glowing spot on the very bottom of it which Mario must ground pound to make the Power Moon appear.

45.name: Water Pooling in the Crevasse
45.description: In the Hollow Crevasse, the player can find a glowing spot on the right side underwater, which Mario must ground pound in order for the Power Moon to appear.

46.name: Squirming Under Ice
46.description: In the Snowy Mountain area where Mario previously fought Rango, the player can find this Power Moon at the very top by ground pounding a Lurker in the ground. Mario can throw Cappy at it to stun it.

47.name: Snow Kingdom Timer Challenge 3
47.description: Near the Corner of the Freezing Sea checkpoint, the player can find a P Switch that is underwater near a Cheep Cheep. The player must press the P Switch and quickly make their way over to the Power Moon before the P Switch's effect wears off.

48.name: Stacked-Up Ice Climb
48.description: In the Icicle Cavern, Mario must capture and create a Goomba Stack consisting of at least ten Goombas and make it to the top of the area onto a Goomba button with a number "10". The Power Moon will appear high in the air and can be obtained simply by jumping while still controlling the Goomba Stack.

49.name: I Met a Snow Cheep Cheep!
49.description: To the west of the Above the Ice Well checkpoint, the player can find the Bonneter biologist near a small pool of water. The player must capture a Cheep Cheep and bring it to the Bonneter who will reward Mario with a Power Moon.

50.name: Even More Walking on Ice!
50.description: The player must go to the same area as the "Walking on Ice!" Power Moon, but this time Mario must earn 90 or more points after which Mario will be rewarded with a Power Moon.

51.name: Snow Kingdom Master Cup
51.description: At the northwest corner of the kingdom, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

52.name: Iceburn Circuit Class A
52.description: Behind the Corner of the Freezing Sea checkpoint the player can find a hidden doorway where the Moon Rock originally was. The player must get in first place in the Iceburn Circuit Class A race track.

53.name: Iceburn Circuit Class S
53.description: The player must get in first place in the Iceburn Circuit Class S race track, which is in the same place as Iceburn Circuit Class A race track.

54.name: Running the Flower Road
54.description: Near the Above the Ice Well checkpoint, the player can find a Moon Pipe which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must throw Cappy at multiple scarecrows to make flower paths appear. The enemies that appear in this area include Moonsnakes and Banzai Bills .

55.name: Looking Back on the Flower Road
55.description: In the area with the "Running the Flower Road" Power Moon, this Power Moon can be found behind the first Banzai Bill Cannon .

1.name: Road to Sky Garden
1.description: The player must traverse through the Iron Road and then defeat the Big Poison Piranha Plant at the end in order to receive this Power Moon.

2.name: Flower Thieves of Sky Garden
2.description: The player will receive a Multi Moon after defeating Spewart on the Sky Garden Tower.

3.name: Path to the Secret Flower Field
3.description: The player must head to the Secret Flower Field and then destroy the cannon blocking the entrance using the nearby Sherms .

4.name: Defend the Secret Flower Field!
4.prerequisite: Path to the Secret Flower Field
4.description: The player will receive a Multi Moon after defeating Torkdrift in the Secret Flower Field.

5.name: Behind the Rock Wall
5.description: Near the Summit Path checkpoint, the player can find a Sherm next to a rock wall. Mario must capture the Sherm and then destroy the top-left corner of the rock wall in order to reveal a Power Moon.

6.name: Back Way Up the Mountain
6.description: Near the Iron Mountain Path, Station 8 checkpoint, the player can find a low platform with an Uproot and some Rock Blocks . Mario must capture the Uproot and use him to destroy the Rock Blocks located in the corner in order to find a hidden passage with an 8-bit pipe . If the player reaches the end of the 2D area here, they will receive a Power Moon.

7.name: Rolling Rock in the Woods
7.description: Near the Odyssey, the player can find a rock between four bushes. If Mario destroys this rock, he will receive a Power Moon.

8.name: Caught Hopping in the Forest!
8.description: Near the Odyssey, the player can find a rabbit. If Mario catches the rabbit, he will receive a Power Moon.

9.name: Thanks for the Charge!
9.description: At the Forest Charging Station, the player can find a glowing spot on the right-most charging station. If Mario ground pounds this spot, a Power Moon will appear.

10.name: Atop the Tall Tree
10.description: In the south-eastern corner of the kingdom, the player can find an Uproot next to a tall tree. Mario must capture the Uproot and use it to climb up the tall tree, where a nut can be found. If the player destroys the nut, they will receive a Power Moon.

11.name: Tucked Away Inside the Tunnel
11.description: In the south-eastern corner of the kingdom, the player can find an Uproot next to a tall tree. Mario must capture the Uproot and then return to the river in the opening area of the kingdom. The player must then head upstream and locate a nut located high up on a wall. Using the Uproot, Mario can reach the nut and destroy it, revealing a Power Moon.

12.name: Over the Cliff's Edge
12.description: Near the Summit Path checkpoint, the player should look for a hidden path behind the cliff wall. If Mario traverses this path, he will find a nut, which will reward a Power Moon when destroyed.

13.name: The Nut 'Round the Corner
13.description: Before reaching the Iron Road: Entrance checkpoint, the player should look for a hidden iron path near Talkatoo . Mario should traverse this hidden path to find a nut, which will reward a Power Moon once destroyed.

14.name: Climb the Cliff to Get the Nut
14.description: From the start of the kingdom, the player should look for the river and follow its path upstream. At the top end of the river, the player will find a cave with a lever and a door. If Mario activates the lever (by throwing Cappy at it), the door will open, allowing him to access a hidden cliffside with an Uproot. Mario should capture the Uproot and use it to climb up the cliffside and find a hidden nut. Destroying the nut will reward the player with a Power Moon.

15.name: The Nut in the Red Maze
15.description: While traversing through the Iron Road, the player should look for a nut hidden in a corner of the maze. If Mario destroys this nut, he will receive a Power Moon.

16.name: The Nut at the Dead End
16.description: From the "Road to Sky Garden" Power Moon, the player should locate a hidden iron path located underneath that Power Moon's location. If Mario reaches the end of this hidden path, he will find a nut that will reward him with a secret Power Moon once destroyed.

17.name: Cracked Nut on a Crumbling Tower
17.description: Between the Iron Road: Halfway Point and the Sky Garden Tower, the player can find a side path made of collapsing platforms. If Mario can traverse these platforms and reach the end of their path, he will find a nut, which will reward a Power Moon once destroyed.

18.name: The Nut that Grew on the Tall Fence
18.description: Near the Iron Mountain Path, Station 8 checkpoint, the player should head across the nearby iron wall to find a hidden nut, which will reward a Power Moon once destroyed.

19.name: Fire in the Cave
19.description: From the Iron Road: Entrance checkpoint, the player should head through an opening between some iron bars along the left side, where a scarecrow can be found. Mario must throw Cappy at the scarecrow, which will open the nearby door and allow access to the cave behind. In the cave, the player must defeat the Fire Bro , which will reward Mario with a Power Moon.

20.name: Hey Out There, Captain Toad!
20.description: From the Observation Deck, the player must capture Glydon and use him to glide to a distant island to the east. On this island, Mario can find Captain Toad , who will give the player a Power Moon.

21.name: Love in the Forest Ruins
21.description: Near the Forest Charging Station, the player can find a field of Goombas . Mario must capture one of the Goombas and then use it to create a Goomba Tower , which can be used to reach Goombette , who is located on a high platform nearby. If the player uses the Goomba Tower to interact with Goombette, she will give the player a Power Moon.

22.name: Inside a Rock in the Forest
22.description: Near the Summit Path checkpoint, the player can find a Sherm on a lower cliff platform. Mario must capture the Sherm and then head back near the Odyssey, where a dirt rock can be found. If the player destroys this dirt rock, they will receive a Power Moon.

23.name: Shopping in Steam Gardens
23.description: The player can purchase a Power Moon from the Crazy Cap Shop for 100 yellow Coins .

24.name: Nut Planted in the Tower
24.description: Inside the Sky Garden Tower, the player can find a nut planted on the central column. If Mario destroys this nut, he will receive a Power Moon.

25.name: Stretching Your Legs
25.description: Inside the Sky Garden Tower, Mario must capture an Uproot and take it to the top of the central column. At the top, the player must stretch the Uproot in order to reach a Power Moon located high above.

26.name: Spinning-Platforms Treasure
26.description: Near the Secret Flower Field, the player should look off the eastern cliff edge to find some hidden iron platforms below. Mario must jump down to these platforms and then traverse across the rotating platforms here in order to reach a Warp Pipe, which will take the player to a secret room containing a Power Moon.

27.name: Make the Secret Flower Field Bloom
27.description: Within the Secret Flower Field, the player can find three groups of un-bloomed flowers. Mario must throw Cappy at all three groups of flowers in order to bloom them all (before they un-bloom) within a short amount of time. If the player blooms all the flowers, they will receive a Power Moon.

28.name: Rolling Rock in the Deep Woods
28.description: At the southern end of the Deep Woods, Mario can find a rock that he can break. If the player can break this rock, they will receive a Power Moon.

29.name: Glowing in the Deep Woods
29.description: In the Deep Woods, the player can find a scarecrow near the pool of the river. Mario must throw Cappy at the scarecrow, which will cause a Power Moon to temporarily spawn nearby. The player must then collect the Power Moon before it disappears.

30.name: Past the Peculiar Pipes
30.description: Along the eastern wall of the Deep Woods, the player can find a Warp Pipe, which will take Mario to a small pipe maze. If the player can successfully traverse through the pipe maze, they will receive a Power Moon.

31.name: By the Babbling Brook in Deep Woods
31.description: In the Deep Woods, the player can find a T-Rex roaming around. If Mario can lure the T-Rex to charge into a solid wall, it will get knocked out, allowing Mario to capture it. The player must then take it to the north-western corner of the Deep Woods (left of the river's origin) and use it to destroy the large rock here. This will reveal a glowing spot on the ground, which Mario can ground pound to reveal a Power Moon.

32.name: The Hard Rock in Deep Woods
32.description: In the Deep Woods, the player can find a T-Rex roaming around. If Mario can lure the T-Rex to charge into a solid wall, it will get knocked out, allowing Mario to capture it. The player must then take it to the south-eastern corner of the Deep Woods (right of the river's end) and use it to destroy the large rock here. This will reveal a glowing spot on the ground, which Mario can ground pound to reveal a Power Moon.

33.name: A Treasure Made from Coins
33.description: In the Deep Woods, the player should look for a hidden Coin Coffer on a small hill. Mario must capture the Coin Coffer and then take it to the pool of the river. Here, the player can find a small plant sprout surrounded by coins. Mario must shoot the sprout with 500 coins in order to have it fully bloom into a flower, which will give the player a Power Moon.

34.name: Beneath the Roots of the Moving Tree
34.description: Along the eastern wall of the Deep Woods, the player can find a small pine tree . If the player captures the tree, they can move it out of the way to reveal a glowing spot on the floor. Mario must then ground pound the glowing spot to reveal a Power Moon.

35.name: Deep Woods Treasure Trap
35.description: Near the southern end of the Deep Woods, the player can find a Warp Pipe coming out of a large tree. Mario must enter the pipe to find a room with three treasure chests. If the player opens them in the correct order (center, left, right), they will receive a Power Moon.

36.name: Exploring for Treasure
36.description: At the northern end of the Deep Woods (where the river's origin is located), the player can find a locked door being guarded by a Steam Gardener. In order to enter this door, the player needs to wear both the Explorer Hat and the Explorer Outfit. Once Mario enters the room, he can find a treasure chest in the center of the room. Opening it will reward the player with a Power Moon.

37.name: Wooded Kingdom Timer Challenge 1
37.description: Next to the Iron Road: Halfway Point checkpoint, the player can find a scarecrow. Mario must throw Cappy onto the scarecrow, which will temporarily reveal some poles and a Power Moon above them. The player must then swing up the poles and collect the Power Moon before it disappears.

38.name: Wooded Kingdom Timer Challenge 2
38.description: At the Forest Charging Station, the player can find a scarecrow on the left-most charging station. Mario must throw Cappy onto the scarecrow, which will temporarily reveal some platforms and a Power Moon above them. The player must then jump up the platforms and collect the Power Moon before it disappears.

39.name: Flooding Pipeway
39.description: Near the Iron Road: Entrance, the player can find a pool of water with a submerged Warp Pipe. Mario should enter this Warp Pipe and then reach the end of the secret area within in order to receive a Power Moon.

40.name: Flooding Pipeway Ceiling Secret
40.description: In the area with the "Flooding Pipeway" Power Moon, the player should look for an opening in the ceiling. Mario must enter this opening in order to find a small alcove with a hidden Power Moon.

41.name: Wandering in the Fog
41.description: Near the Forest Charging Station, the player can find a Mini Rocket on an iron platform. Mario should capture the rocket to be taken to a secret area covered in fog, where he must find and collect five Moon Shards . If he can collect them all, he will receive a Power Moon.

42.name: Nut Hidden in the Fog
42.description: In the area with the "Wandering in the Fog" Power Moon, the player can find a nut hidden behind an iron platform on the northern side of the area. If Mario destroys this nut, he will receive a secret Power Moon.

43.name: Flower Road Run
43.description: From the Summit Path checkpoint, the player should head to the back side of the large sloped ramp, where a hidden door can be found. Mario must enter this door and then reach the end of the secret area within in order to receive a Power Moon.

44.name: Flower Road Reach
44.description: In the area with the "Flower Road Run" Power Moon, the player must capture a Goomba and then use it to create a Goomba Tower. This will allow Mario to reach the hidden Power Moon located on a high iron platform that he could otherwise not reach.

45.name: Elevator Escalation
45.description: At the Summit Path checkpoint, the player should locate a hidden door at the top-right side of the large sloped ramp. Mario should enter this door and then reach the end of the secret area within in order to find a Power Moon.

46.name: Elevator Blind Spot
46.description: In the area with the "Elevator Escalation" Power Moon, the player must capture a Sherm at the start of the area and then use it to shoot and destroy a hidden rock located on the back wall. This will reward Mario with a Power Moon.

47.name: Walking on Clouds
47.description: Near the Secret Flower Field Entrance, the player can find a Steam Gardener that will give a seed once activated. Mario must then carry this seed to the large seed pot on the Observation Deck. This will take him to a secret area in the clouds. If the player reaches the end of this area, they will receive a Power Moon.

48.name: Above the Clouds
48.description: In the area with the "Walking on Clouds" Power Moon, the player must capture an Uproot at the start of the area and use it to reach a hidden Power Moon located high above the platform in the center of the area.

49.name: Secret Path to the Steam Gardens!
49.description: This Power Moon can be found inside the Iron Cage. To reach it, the player must travel through a painting located in a different kingdom: If the player visits the Wooded Kingdom before the Lake Kingdom and visits the Snow Kingdom after the Seaside Kingdom , then the painting can be found on a high cliff ledge at the north end of the starting area in the Snow Kingdom. If the player visits the Wooded Kingdom before the Lake Kingdom and visits the Seaside Kingdom after the Snow Kingdom, then the painting can be found inside the Crystal Palace at the center of the Seaside Kingdom. If the player visits the Wooded Kingdom after the Lake Kingdom, then the painting can be found on a ledge hidden directly behind the Odyssey in the Metro Kingdom .

50.name: Found with Wooded Kingdom Art
50.description: Near the Odyssey, the player should look for a picture of the Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Trace-Walking mini-game in the Sand Kingdom, along with two bushes north of his location. If the player then returns to the Sand Kingdom, locates these two bushes and ground pounds next to them, they will be rewarded with a hidden Power Moon.

51.name: Swing Around Secret Flower Field
51.prerequisite: Defend the Secret Flower Field! and complete the game
51.description: On the west side on top of the Secret Flower Field gate, Mario can find a golden rod where he can descend to a crumbling walkway in which he must then Long Jump to the red pole ahead. Mario will have to jump to and from a series of poles until he lands on a set of gray Brick Blocks with a Key and P Switch on them. The key will unveil the Power Moon on the east side of the gate, and the P switch activates a flower road that leads Mario directly to the Power Moon.

52.name: Jammin' in the Wooded Kingdom
52.prerequisite: Defend the Secret Flower Field! and complete the game
52.description: By the stream above the waterfall located southeast of the kingdom, the player can find a Jammin' Toad . Should Mario talk to the Toad, he will request that the player play a specific piece of music related to "sky-high coins aplenty". The Toad will reward Mario with a Power Moon if the player selects the "Above the Clouds" (#75) theme from the Music List .

53.name: Wooded Kingdom Regular Cup
53.prerequisite: Defend the Secret Flower Field! and complete the game
53.description: At the Forest Charging Station, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

54.name: Peach in the Wooded Kingdom
54.prerequisite: Defend the Secret Flower Field! and talk to the Toad at Peach's Castle
54.description: At the Observation Deck, the player can find Princess Peach . Talking to her will reward Mario with a Power Moon.

55.name: High Up in the Cave
55.description: This moon is located inside the small cave connecting the woods to Steam Gardens proper. Due to its elevation, Mario must either capture an Uproot to stretch toward it, capture a Fire Bro and jump as a Fire Bro, or perform a variety of jump techniques (such as a Ground Pound Jump and a Dive Jump) to reach it.

56.name: Lost in the Tall Trees
56.description: There is a tall pine tree in the eastern woods with a wooden platform attached, and a wooden crate on said platform. Mario can either head to the Observation Deck, capture Glydon, and release capture, then ground pound the crate to release the Power Moon, which lands over to the golden rod nearby the Summit Path, or capture a Sherm below the Summit Path and destroy the crate with a Sherm.

57.name: Looking Down on the Goombas
57.description: This moon is inside a nut on top of the tall iron wall nearby where Goombette can be found. It can only be reached by capturing Glydon and flying west to the nut. Afterwards, Mario must then simply break the nut open to obtain the Power Moon.

58.name: High Up on a Rock Wall
58.description: On the Iron Road, there is a nut high above the trio of gray brick blocks nearby the red iron maze. Mario must use an Uproot to stretch to the brick blocks, then stretch to the nut to open it and release the Power Moon.

59.name: The Nut in the Robot Storeroom
59.description: Inside the storeroom with the off-duty Steam Gardeners, there is a nut above both the entrance and two Volbonan tourists. Mario can reach it by stretching toward it as an Uproot. Opening the nut unveils the Power Moon.

60.name: Above the Iron Mountain Path
60.description: West of the Iron Mountain Path, Station 8 checkpoint, there is a small cliff. Traveling north from there across a brittle iron pathway leads to another cliff with a P switch, which when activated, reveals a flower road leading to the Sky Garden Tower. On the way there, the flower path will lead Mario directly to the Power Moon, high above the start of the Iron Road.

61.name: The Nut Under the Observation Deck
61.description: Underneath the northeast corner of the Observation Deck, there is a nut so high up on the wall, that a fully stretched Uproot alone can't reach it. As an Uproot, Mario must find a row of four Hidden Blocks against the wall, allowing Mario to stretch from said blocks up to the nut where the Power Moon lies.

62.name: Bird Traveling the Forest
62.description: This bluebird holding this Power Moon flies around the Iron Road, Sky Garden Tower, and the Forest Charging Station. The player must find a place where the bird flies closest to their footing for the best chance of the player being able to throw Cappy to the bird and revealing the Power Moon.

63.name: Invader in the Sky Garden
63.description: The player must defeat the Yoofoe on top of Sky Garden Tower to obtain this moon.

64.name: Hot, Hot, Hot from the Campfire
64.description: Nearby the lake where Talkatoo is found, a Volbonan tourist set up some firewood but can't start a fire. Mario must find and capture a Fire Bro. , then return to the said firewood to light the Volbonan's campfire. A Power Moon appears upon lighting the firewood.

65.name: Wooded Kingdom Timer Challenge 3
65.description: West of the Iron Mountain Path, Station 8 checkpoint, there is a small cliff with a scarecrow . Throwing Cappy on it temporarily reveals an obstacle course along the wall heading west. The path consists of two moving lifts and two bars to swing on. The player must reach the end of the course and grab the Power Moon before time runs out.

66.name: Moon Shards in the Forest
66.description: Five Moon Shards are scattered throughout the red iron maze in the Iron Road. Collecting all five reveals the Power Moon right next to the Iron Road: Halfway Point checkpoint flag.

67.name: Taking Notes: On Top of the Wall
67.description: On top the southeast portion of the natural wall surrounding the southern forest, a rainbow treble clef can be found. Touching it reveals a very long trail of notes leading all the way back to the where the Odyssey lands in this kingdom. Due to the rather tight time limit, Mario must roll along the trail to cover more time, but he must also be cautious as the path gets narrower near the end, and could risk falling off course. The Power Moon appears near exactly where the last note is, after Mario has collected all the notes.

68.name: Taking Notes: Stretching
68.description: Along the northern wall below the Iron Cage, there is another rainbow treble clef. The set of notes revealed vaguely form a "V" shape, and most notes are best reached by stretching upward as an Uproot. The Power Moon revealed also has a high altitude that can best be reached by an Uproot.

69.name: Wooded Kingdom Master Cup
69.description: At the Forest Charging Station, the player can find a Koopa Troopa hosting the Koopa Freerunning mini-game. Mario must enter the race and then reach the finish line in first place to be awarded a Power Moon.

70.name: I Met an Uproot!
70.description: On the northernmost tower of the region, the player can find the Bonneter biologist who wants to see an Uproot up close for research purposes. Mario must find and capture an Uproot then travel to where the Bonneter awaits where he will reward Mario a Power Moon.

71.name: Invisible Road: Danger!
71.description: To the left of the "Path to the Secret Flower Field" Power Moon, the player can find a Moon Pipe which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must walk across an invisible pathway while avoiding Poison Piranha Plants. At the end, he must defeat three Big Poison Piranha Plants to unlock the Power Moon.

72.name: Invisible Road: Hidden Room
72.description: In the area with the "Invisible Road: Danger!" Power Moon, the player must go to the part with the invisible rotating platform and find a hidden invisible platform with a small alcove. Inside this alcove is a treasure chest containing the Power Moon.

73.name: Herding Sheep Above the Forest Fog
73.description: Near the Forest Charging Station in the area with the Goombas, the player can find a Moon Pipe which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must lead a sheep through a short series of obstacles to a circular area which can be reached by climbing a pole. Mario will be rewarded with a Power Moon if done successfully.

74.name: Herding Sheep on the Iron Bridge
74.description: In the area with the "Herding Sheep Above the Forest Fog" Power Moon, the player can find a Warp Pipe in a hidden alcove near the sheep's pen which will take Mario to an area with another sheep and a P Switch. Mario must hit the P Switch and then quickly lead the sheep to the same pen before the P Switch's effect wears off. If done successfully, Mario will be rewarded with another Power Moon.

75.name: Down and Back Breakdown Road
75.description: Near the Iron Road: Entrance, the player can find a Moon Pipe on a wall which leads to a bonus area. In this bonus area, Mario must run across many breakable blocks which can be destroyed by the many Bullet Bills found here. At the end, Mario must collect a key and go back to where he started in the area to collect the unlocked Power Moon. Even in Assist Mode, Mario will die and lose 10 coins if he falls into the bottomless area. [1]

76.name: Below Breakdown Road
76.description: In the area with the "Down and Back Breakdown Road" Power Moon, Mario must get to the end of the area and drop down to the lower level. He must then capture the Banzai Bill found there and fly back to the start into a wall made of breakable blocks where the Power Moon is found.
